jobs.description_text: Overview The Opportunity Get started on an exciting and meaningful career path, working on innovative, challenging projects and learning from industry experts as part of PM Group’s world leading multi-discipline team. Who are PM Group? PM Group is a leading International engineering, architecture, project and construction management firm. With a network of offices in Europe, Asia, UK and the US and a multi-discipline team of 3,700 people, we deliver complex, capital projects in the life sciences, food and beverages, mission critical/ICT, advanced manufacturing, energy and environmental sectors. We are 100% employee owned so work together to make our company successful. Responsibilities As a Chemical Engineering professional at PM Group, your first two years will bring opportunities to develop your knowledge and experience across a multitude of areas, with a rich variety of new challenges in design, operation and commissioning. You will work as part of a multi-disciplined team on projects in the following sectors – Mission Critical, Pharma, Med Tech, Advanced Manufacturing, Food and Energy. Your work assignments will involve rotation through different projects, covering areas such as: Process Safety, Process Plant Operation, Process Optimization/Modelling, Process Unit Operations, Design Calculations. Qualifications A Primary Honours Degree/Masters in Chemical Engineering , Proficiency in engineering software as well as MS Word and Excel, Good verbal and written communications skills and the ability to work in a vibrant multi discipline design environment, Strong work ethic and the ability to produce accurate work to strict project deadlines, Flexibility to work both in design office and on construction teams. What are we offering? An exciting and meaningful career path, working on innovative, challenging projects and learning from industry experts as part of PM Group’s world leading multi-discipline team. PM Group’s structured Graduate Programme will help you to reach your full potential. As a participant you will have varied and diverse work experiences on office and site based assignments. Our Graduate Programme includes on the job coaching, mentoring, formal learning modules and support for professional status. We offer a competitive salary with opportunities to travel and gain a variety of experiences. It's not all work. At PM Group we work hard, but we make sure to have fun too! Be part of the bigger picture and apply today

Company Overview NeoDyne is a leading engineering company specialising in industrial automation, digital manufacturing, and electrical engineering solutions. We develop high-availability automation and electrical systems for mission-critical industries, including pharmaceutical manufacturing, data centres, and energy infrastructure, ensuring continuous operation and compliance. Our expertise extend across power generation, natural gas transmission, and high-voltage system design, delivering robust solutions that strengthen critical infrastructure. Within our Transmission & Distribution team, we deliver mission-critical design packages that transform the reliability, availability, and efficiency of the energy network, moving it towards a greener, more sustainable future. Department highlights include: Driving complex design delivery: We design AIS/GIS substations from 20kV to 220kV and contestable build and non-contestable stations in the range of 40 to 550MVA CCGT. Delivery of high-complexity design frameworks : NeoDyne is a gas network design framework supplier, playing a significant role in providing electrical and instrumentation engineering services for the on-shore Natural Gas Industry and Regulated gas utility sector in Ireland and the UK. Our expertise include Compressor Station, AGI Electrical & Instrumentation design, Fiscal and non-Fiscal metering, and Cathodic Protection. With a team of 220+ skilled engineers, our expertise spans the entire project lifecycle, from design and implementation to commissioning and operations. From our offices in Ireland, the UK, Romania, and the US, we operate on a global scale, combining technical expertise with local delivery. We support customers across Europe, North America, and Asia, delivering tailored engineering services that drive long-term success. This Graduate opportunity is offered as a full-time permanent contract, based at our Dublin Office , with an excellent salary and benefits package. jobs.description_text:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.


ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future. 


About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

          

Location: Limerick/Cork/Dublin, Ireland

Are you looking to work for a company that is Ahead of What’s Possible…. a company where you are empowered to Act with Courage, to Build great teams, to Create the future, and to Drive for Excellence?  If so, then Analog Devices International (ADI) is the place for you.

Leading Edge Technology; From digital healthcare to 5G connectivity, from autonomous and electric vehicles to the digitised factory, Analog Devices is passionate about turning tomorrow's possibilities into reality, making the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener. Wherever digital meets physical we’re there.  Virtually every wireless call, text, and download today passes through an Analog Devices IC. Our automotive battery monitoring technology is used in the majority of petrol and diesel engine cars with engine start-stop functionality.  This helped prevent 33 million metric tonnes of carbon vehicle emissions last year globally, which is more than half of all the carbon emissions the whole of Ireland produces in a single year. In digital xray imaging our technology enables delivery of increasingly high image fidelity at lower radiation dosages. Because we are dedicated to solving the toughest engineering challenges, Analog Devices is one of the top 10 semiconductor companies in the world. 

We don’t just talk about innovation, we live it; At ADI, we believe that work should be exciting and meaningful. We encourage initiative and creativity, and we actively support the free exchange of ideas. A career with ADI means taking part in innovation and being challenged to achieve, and it offers the opportunity to work with other talented people, using state-of-the art processes and equipment. We run an annual Innovation Award for our Co-ops, a Global Early Employee Challenge for recent grads, and Hackathons for our wider community of employees. At ADI we strive to be Ahead of What’s Possible.

Silicon Meets Software; Software development at ADI spans from edge nodes to generating insights in the cloud – and everything in between.  Working with hardware teams, your software skills in planning, systems architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, debugging, and testing can help to unlock the potential of our algorithms, technology platforms, and systems to make a real-world impact. Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include; IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure.  As ADI continues to grow its software capability we’re also focussed on building expertise in the area of Machine Learning and AI.  We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real.

One Company, Unlimited Opportunity; The scale of Analog Devices and the range of technologies we develop, markets we serve, countries we operate in, and skills that we utilise, makes for an exciting opportunity for you to find your direction. The opportunities for you at ADI are endless and we actively encourage you to explore those opportunities. From our Graduate Rotation Program, to our Continuing Education policies, to how we actively encourage internal mobility, ADI helps you to plot your path to success.

We hire Graduates primarily from Electronics, Software, Computer Science, Physics, Maths Science, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Artificial Intelligence & Robotics and Chemical & Biochemical disciplines. Our grad opportunities work in areas like IC Design, Product Applications, Design Verification, Design Evaluation, Layout, Embedded Software, Software Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Process Engineering, Failure Analysis, RF Design, Research Science, Technical Marketing, Test Development, Packaging, Quality, Reliability and Supply Chain.

Why Join ADI?

  • Competitive Salary, Bonus Scheme, plus relocation assistance
  • Competitive Holiday Allowance
  • Graduate Rotation Programme for all new Grads to experience different functions and enhance skills
  • Learning Opportunities/ Access to Cutting Edge Technology
  • Variety of Networks and Sports & Social Clubs
  • Subsidised Canteen and Free Tea and Coffee Stations
  • Onsite Occupational Health Clinic
  • Cutting edge facilities in our European Research & Design Centre

We will be recruiting for Graduate positions from September 2026 on a rolling basis until all positions filled.

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export  licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.  As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

Job Req Type: Graduate Job

          

Required Travel: No

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact




Join the Jacobs Graduate Development Program (GDP) and help shape better environments, communities and societies. Bring your passion, creativity and ambition — and together, we’ll create lasting change. 




What You’ll Get 




Our two‑year Graduate Development Program is designed to accelerate your growth as you begin your Jacobs career. Through blended learning, mentoring, progress reviews and networking, you’ll build capability across four key areas: human skills, consulting skills, championing our strategy, and developing your personal passions. 




You’ll tailor your learning journey to your interests, career goals and technical strengths — creating a graduate experience that’s uniquely yours. Much of your development will come through real project work, supported by your manager and mentor to ensure you gain the experiences that matter most. 




The Graduate Development Program isn’t just a steppingstone — it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain the tools, exposure and support to unlock your potential, working on meaningful projects and collaborating with industry leaders to deliver solutions to complex challenges. 




About the opportunity




At Jacobs, we’re committed to helping you build a career, not just a job. As part of Cities & Places and Major Programmes, you’ll join a community of passionate professionals delivering some of the UK and Ireland’s most iconic infrastructure projects – from HS2 and Thames Tideway to the Palace of Westminster Restoration and Lower Thames Crossing.




We’re looking for enthusiastic and motivated Graduate Project Managers to join our high-performing team. This is a fantastic opportunity to kick-start your career in project management, working alongside industry-leading experts on major programmes across transportation, water, energy, defence, healthcare, and the built environment.




What you’ll be doing:




As a Graduate Project Manager, you’ll be supported to learn and grow while contributing to real projects from day one. You will:




Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to support project delivery.
Assist in planning, monitoring, and reporting on project progress.
Help identify and manage risks and issues.
Support stakeholder engagement and communication activities.
Contribute to the development of project documentation and presentations.
Learn and apply project management tools and techniques.
Participate in continuous improvement and innovation initiatives.




The start date for this position is September 2027.

Here's what you'll need




Be working towards a relevant Degree or Master’s level qualification in Business Management, Buildings related disciplines or Project Management
A flexible, proactive mindset and motivation to drive your career forward 
Adaptability and enthusiasm for learning 
Permanent right to work in Ireland 




Selection Process 




Apply Online 
Solo Video Assessment

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Systems Architecture
jobs.description_text:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

In this role, you will lead the architectural design and technical integration for our digital platforms, ensuring scalable and secure AI-enabled solutions.


What you’ll be doing…

  • Designing and updating architectural blueprints for complex, integrated digital platforms, including decoupled API hooks and Remote SIM Provisioning flows, and modular integration endpoints capable of supporting AI-enabled features.
  • Evaluating alternative technical solutions, assessing system feasibility, performance costs, security safeguards, and scalability - including data privacy, latency, and cost-efficiency considerations when incorporating third-party AI tools.
  • Facilitating daily scrums, sprint planning, backlogs, and release execution for digital product features, encouraging the practical adoption of AI-assisted development, testing, and documentation tools across scrums to improve delivery efficiency.
  • Coordinating technical delivery schedules between internal engineering, QA teams, and third-party vendor developers.


What we're looking for...


You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or Technology, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Experience working with microservices architecture, API integrations, and Agile release frameworks.
  • Experience integrating third-party AI APIs into existing microservices and leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools within an Agile SDLC.

Even better if you have…

  • The ability to develop and maintain technical architecture blueprints, system integration models, and cloud platform specifications, ensuring modular support for emerging AI and automation services.
  • The ability to evaluate alternative technical solutions, conducting feasibility studies regarding system reliability, scalability, cost-effectiveness, and security.
  • An understanding of agile sprint planning, daily scrums, release coordination, and cross-functional engineering deliverables, incorporating AI-assisted coding and QA tools to streamline release cycles.
  • Experience overseeing third-party technical integrations and API delivery schedules.



Why Verizon?


Verizon is committed to maintaining a Total Rewards package which is competitive, valued by our employees, and differentiates us as an Employer of Choice.

  • We are a ‘pay for performance’ company and your contribution is rewarded through competitive salaries and performance-based incentives. We create an opportunity for us all to share in the success of Verizon and the value we help to create through this broad-based discretionary equity award program.
  • Your benefits are market competitive and delivered by some of the best providers.
  • You are provided with a full spectrum of health and wellbeing resources, including a first in-class Employee Assistance Program, to empower you to make positive health decisions.
  • We offer generous paid time off benefits to help you manage your work life balance and opportunities for flexible working arrangements*.
  • Verizon provides training and development for all levels, to help you enhance your skills and develop your career, from funding towards education assistance, award-winning training, online development tools and access to industry research.
  • You will be able to take part in volunteering opportunities as part of our environmental, community and sustainability commitment.
  • Benefit packages are tailored to the specific country where a position is based.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.



Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

37.5

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Credit & Collections
jobs.description_text:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.  

We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. 

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security? 




This is the operational and forecasting backbone behind how Cohesity collects on what it bills. As Senior Collections Manager, you own global collections forecasting, cash performance, and credit-policy compliance, and you lead the team responsible for the health of the receivables book.This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead a distributed, global collections team, own the forecasting and risk tools that protect cash flow, and be the person leadership leans on to explain exposure, variance, and the plan to close the gap.


HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:


  • Weekly & Quarterly Collections Forecasting
  • Own the weekly collections forecast: against the quarterly benchmark, identifying variances and driving corrective action across regions.
  • Build and maintain the forecasting models that cash-flow decisions are made against, including gross/net cumulative views and disti-level detail.
  • Reconcile forecast to actuals and partner with Accounting on cash application and adjustments.
  • Credit Policy, Risk & Compliance
  • Ensure collections practices comply with the Global Credit & Bookings Policy, including credit limits, exception handling, and escalation paths.
  • Own the Global Aging Report cadence and the credit watchlist: flagging at-risk accounts and quantifying exposure.
  • Partner with Sales and Legal on collection strategy for at-risk and past-due accounts.
  • Lead and develop a global collections team spanning India and the US, ensuring workload is distributed evenly and coverage scales with account volume.
  • Design and defend the coverage model with data: accounts per FTE, AR dollars per FTE, and aging-weighted load.
  • Own headcount and backfill planning for the collections team, partnering with Recruiting on requisitions.
  • Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Deliver clear, accurate collections and cash performance reporting to Finance and Sales leadership.
  • Partner with Deal Desk, Legal, and Renewals Sales to resolve billing disputes and remove friction from the collections lifecycle.
  • Govern the integrity of collections data across NetSuite and Salesforce.

WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:


  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; a professional credit or accounting qualification is a plus.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience in Credit & Collections or AR management, including people-management experience, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS company.
  • Demonstrated mastery of AR/collections metrics: DSO, aging, and how collections performance flows to cash and the financials.
  • Strong Excel skills, with the ability to build scalable, auditable forecasting models.
  • Proven ability to lead distributed teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

WE ARE EXTRA EXCITED IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING:


  • Direct experience owning a global or multi-region collections operation.
  • Fluency with NetSuite, Salesforce, and Excel-based forecasting tools.
  • Proven use of AI-native tools (e.g.Claude) to automate forecasting and reporting workflows.
  • Experience at a US-headquartered, high-growth technology company with a global or EMEA collections remit is strongly preferred — for example, companies such as Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Datadog, HubSpot, Stripe, Zendesk, Veeam, or NetApp, ideally with exposure to a Dublin/Cork EMEA finance hub.

HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED:


  • Collections forecast held within a tight, agreed tolerance against the quarterly benchmark.
  • A single, trusted credit watchlist and aging view that leadership uses to manage bad-debt exposure.
  • Coverage model that is demonstrably even and scales cleanly with account volume growth.
  • Recognized within 6 months as the go-to authority on global collections performance and risk.

From assessing risks and supporting audits to collaborating with teams across the business, they play a key role in protecting both the company and its customers while gaining exposure to a wide range of business functions. Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security? 

We are hiring Services Sales Specialist to launch the new post-sales selling motion within Global Professional Services. The role will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Partners and PS Delivery to attach the right post-sales services to accelerate customer adoption of the Cohesity platform, and drive measurable ARR uplift through value realised at every stage of the customer journey.  As the first hires into the global Services Sales function, you will help shape how Cohesity sells services going forward across the EMEA region. This includes which offerings get prioritised, how attach is measured, and how PS partners with the broader commercial organisation.  This position is an integral part of the sales cycle, collaborating with the Account teams especially in large and complex engagement, to expand the content and depth of Cohesity services.

HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:

  • PS attach across EMEA. You are the commercial owner of services from RFP and initial deal scoping through close and into renewal.

  • Services scoping and proposals. You partner with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, and PS Architects, and Delivery Governance Leads to scope the right professional services engagement and validate delivery assumptions and feasibility before close, for each customer,  using the productized SKU portfolio or creating custom requirements as applicable. 

  • Commercial discipline on services pricing and discounting. You ensure services pricing reflects the value delivered, that discounts are applied with discipline, and that service credits are deployed only against defined success plans — not as concessionary throw-ins.

  • Customer journey alignment. You map professional services to the customer's journey — initial deployment, ongoing optimisation, strategic advisory — and ensure the right offerings are positioned at the right moment.

  • Partner-led services orchestration. Where appropriate, you orchestrate with the partner ecosystem to deliver services through certified partners — ensuring the right delivery path for each customer, the right margin economics for Cohesity, and the right experience for the end customer.

  • Pipeline management and forecasting. You manage your services pipeline in Salesforce with rigour, forecast accurately, and provide weekly visibility to Sales and PS leadership.

  • Voice of the customer. You are a primary commercial channel for what offerings customers actually want — feeding back to Services Product Management and PS leadership on portfolio gaps, pricing friction, and competitive dynamics.

WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:

  • 8+ years in enterprise technology sales, with significant time selling professional services, software services, or solution-based engagements at scale to F1000 customers.

  • Proven services-led seller or services-attached commercial role — selling complex, multi-stakeholder engagements where services value had to be articulated, scoped, and priced credibly.

  • Deep understanding of data protection, backup/recovery, cyber resilience, or infrastructure modernisation. You can speak the customer's technical language and partner credibly with SEs and architects on the technical and commercial dimensions of a deal.

  • Strong AE partnership track record. You know how to build trust with sellers who own the customer relationship, complement rather than compete with them, and drive joint outcomes that neither side could achieve alone.

  • Commercial discipline. You understand services unit economics — margin, utilisation, scoping risk, comp structure — and use that fluency to scope deals correctly and avoid concessionary outcomes that erode profitability.

  • Comfort with productized offerings AND custom solutions. You can sell off-the-shelf SKUs at scale and shape larger custom engagements when the strategic moment requires it — and know the difference.

  • Executive presence. You can engage at different levels of the customer stakeholders spanning Infrastructure, and Security leadership with the same fluency you bring to a deal-review with the regional sales lead.

  • Bias for action and ownership. You operate at the intersection of Sales, PS, CS, and Partner — and you drive outcomes without owning every function.

We are looking for someone who has built and run this kind of motion — not someone who has theorized about it.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Cohesity or comparable data management and cyber-resilience platforms.

  • Background in services-led selling motions including productized SKUs, retainer/subscription services, and outcome-based commercials.

  • Familiarity with services attach as a measured commercial discipline (TSIA frameworks, attach-rate benchmarks, services-led GTM models).

  • Experience as a foundational hire in a new commercial function — including helping shape playbooks, comp plans, and operating norms.

  • Salesforce-driven pipeline management and forecasting; comfort operating in a high-rigour commercial cadence.

  • Experience with ELAs, renewal-driven commercials, and multi-year modernisation commitments.

  • MBA or advanced degree welcomed but not required — we value builders over credentials.

Professional Services is the team that turns Cohesity adoption into accelerated customer outcomes — at scale. The Services Sales function is the commercial engine that connects our offerings to the customers who will benefit most.

AIG is looking for candidates for the Security Remediation Team, which is part of Cyber Threat and Vulnerability Management under ISO.  Our goal is to detect, respond and protect from cyber threat actors, and to provide AIG and our clients a safe cyber experience.
SRT's objective is to prevent vulnerabilities from being exploited by managing application and infrastructure changes using highly efficient and transparent strategies.  We do this by interacting directly with business units, applications and systems owners (both domestic and international) and review threat intelligence data that affect AIG assets.   SRT provides the business and systems owners guidance to remediate or mitigate these cyber threats within specific SLA timeframes based on severity.
The candidate will learn from experienced personnel how to use various industry leading security tools, and also an in-house system built with various API level integrations which provides a unique single "pane of glass" overview of AIG's database of assets worldwide.
Responsibilities for this role are:
* Partner with AIG's world class Threat Intelligence teams and review the latest cyber threats.
* Analyze these vulnerabilities and against AIG assets to effectively rank and triage these threats.
* Engage with application owners, systems administrators, and business delivery teams to ensure that they are able to create actionable and informed decisions.
* Provide timelines and other reporting views to our business executives for progress of these remediation's against SLAs.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.

AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities.  If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com.

Software Engineer

 

Job Title: Software Engineer

Department & Team: Conversational AI, Voice

At Genesys, we believe that exceptional customer experiences are built on the foundation of intelligent, empathetic technology. The voice team is responsible for features and considerations unique to audio interactions.

The Software Engineer will be responsible for the development of components and services used to deliver mission critical cloud products. You will work in a cloud-based environment where continuous change, innovation and experimentation are all encouraged. You will iteratively deliver software in a true DevOps model following CI/CD and agile best practices.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Management - Client Data Onboarding, BE&O
jobs.description_text:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Manager, Product Management - Client Data Onboarding, BE&O

Manager, Product Management – Client Data Onboarding, BE&O

As a member of the Client Data Onboarding Product Management team, you will own and manage our AI-led client data onboarding product. We are rapidly replacing manual ETL with agentic workflows, evolving how we onboard clients in the age of AI, and scaling onboarding across industries and pillars. We are looking for AI-native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI-enhanced version of client data onboarding.

This role reports to the Director of Global Product Management within BE&O's Client Data Onboarding team.

Position Responsibilities

Product Manager for Mastercard's AI-led client data onboarding product, with specific focus on data pipelines, data quality and the onboarding user experience.

Partner with Engineering and Data Science leads to define the agentic workflows for data onboarding. Define functional and non-functional requirements for agents, automated data loading, data quality checks and the web app.

Keep users in control. Design the human-in-the-loop experience with UX, so that Data Engineers and ACS users can review, edit and approve each agent output, and answer Client Data Requests (CDRs) quickly and with confidence.

Develop product strategy derived from user research, client data complexity, onboarding pain points and commercial priorities.

Translate a deep understanding of our users and clients into an actionable roadmap. Deliver the early adopter MVP, then scale across R&C industries and FI clients.

Own end-to-end feature development. Identify and prioritize problems, define use cases, write requirements and acceptance criteria, support development and end-to-end testing, and measure impact through onboarding time, approval effort, data quality and reduction in manual Data Delivery support.

Manage dependencies and delivery risk. Align with the owners of client connectivity, the data ingestion pipeline, Databricks set-up, historical data migration from APT and Data Engineer capacity. Plan interim delivery options where necessary and escalate gaps early.

Drive governance and launch readiness. Make sure that responsible AI, security, privacy, data, architecture and BizOps requirements are completed for production, and that PCI/PII data is handled correctly.

Work as a part of a cross-functional product team to bring ideas to life. Work together with Engineering, UX, Data Delivery, ACS, the R&C and FI pillars, and C&D to align priorities, client roll-out plans and ownership boundaries.

Guide and mentor junior team members through work reviews and sharing of product management practices to foster continuous improvement.



All About You

Experience working on data and analytics products involving large client datasets, data pipelines, ETL and complex business logic

Experience building with AI, LLMs and agents to enhance approaches and/or gain efficiencies, including human-in-the-loop workflows

Working knowledge of data modelling, data contracts, semantic layers, data quality and modern data platforms such as Databricks; hands-on data engineering is beneficial but not essential

Prior Product Management experience – in product or similar roles, with a proven track record of shaping product priorities based on customer and market feedback

Experience delivering internal platforms or workflow tools, working closely with UX to design for expert users

Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable, phased roadmap with measurable outcomes

Creative problem-solver, can balance competing needs across delivery dates, scope, dependencies and risk, and prioritize thoughtfully

Familiarity with data privacy, security and responsible AI governance, ideally in a regulated or financial-services environment

Strong professional presence and influencing skills. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills, with the ability to align engineering, delivery and business stakeholders

5+ years of professional experience in a similar role, or equivalent

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

The Manager, Execution Planner supports the supply planning process for both external manufacturing and internal sites. This role ensures alignment with customer and market demand while maintaining operational efficiency. The execution planner will interact with internal and external supply sites, logistics, and other supply chain teams. Responsibilities include assisting in the development of supply strategies, helping to create and execute supply plans, and identifying and reporting any risks or constraints that may affect product availability.


•         Supply Planning and Execution:

o   Develop and manage supply plans for materials related to product portfolios

o   Support coordination with internal and external manufacturing sites to help balance customer service with operational efficiency.

o   Maintain accurate inventory levels, ensuring purchase orders are up to date for Drug Substance, Drug Product and Finished goods to meet demand

•         Customer and Stakeholder Engagement:

o   Build and maintain relationships with global and local supply chain teams and market stakeholders, collaborating to ensure continuity of supply and identify potential risks

o   Attend supply chain meetings to ensure alignment on customer requirements and consumption plans

•         Demand & Supply Alignment:

o   Use ERP systems (e.g., SAP) to manage demand propagation and supply requirements, ensuring the MRP planning process runs effectively

o   Monitor changes in demand, communicate with stakeholders to adjust production plans, and incorporate these changes into site production schedules

•         Risk Management & Problem Solving:

o   Monitor and assess inventory risks, including shortages, excess stock, and obsolescence

o   Assist to identify and resolve supply constraints, working closely with necessary stakeholders

o   Support inventory risks related to regulatory or artwork changes

•         Metrics and Reporting:

o   Track and report on key supply chain performance metrics such as backorders, inventory compliance, and PO accuracy

o   Provide input into inventory projections, budget processes, and root cause analysis for any supply issues

o   Contribute to monthly and quarterly stock overviews, identifying any inventory risks or supply disruptions

•         Projects & Continuous Improvement:

o   Participate in supply chain improvement projects and other initiatives to optimize supply chain processes

o   Support new product introductions, government tender supply programs, and clinical supply requests when required

o   Ensure that master data is accurately maintained and continuously updated in collaboration with relevant teams

•         Digital Acumen, Analytics, and Learning

o   Leverages visualization and data contextualization tools including Excel and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), integrated APS capabilities, and BMS platforms to monitor KPIs, perform root cause analysis, review best action analysis and provide data-driven decision support.

o   Contributes to process improvements through digitization and automation of planning workflows, supporting improved speed and accuracy.

o   Executes task-level work using available tools (e.g. WMS, SAP, Tableau, Riverlogic, Kinaxis), follows SOPs, fulfills orders, and maintains high level of performance across data and planning accuracy.

o   Demonstrates curiosity and adaptability in learning new digital tools and platforms (e.g., SAP, Kinaxis, forecasting systems), quickly integrating them into daily operations.

o   Strong Planning and financial acumen with understanding of ERP transaction codes, planning/operational software, physical and transactional flows, etc.

o   Familiarity with AI and ML systems features including performance & expectation management, optimization, etc.

jobs.description_text:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This job is a functional expert who participates in complex problem resolution and leads diverse scope projects requiring an understanding of current business trends. Determines methods and procedures for new or special assignments, with initiatives often resulting in global process improvements.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex projects of diverse scope requiring an understanding of current business trends.
  • Participate in complex problem resolution and determine methods for new assignments.
  • Implement initiatives that result in global process improvements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product sales strategies.
  • Provide expertise in product knowledge and market insights to enhance sales efforts.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Job Summary

Sr. Manager, Product Sales – PSC (Payment Services & Crypto) is part of the Rest of Europe and Israel Commercial sales team, partnering with Account Management to grow adoption and transaction margin for PayPal's PSC portfolio across new and existing accounts in the Region.

The PSC portfolio spans the following solution areas: (1) Payouts, including Enterprise Payouts for platforms and marketplaces disbursing funds globally via bank transfers, cards, wallets and local payout methods, and PayPal Payouts for self-serve batch payments to PayPal and Venmo accounts; (2) Risk-as-a-Service (RaaS), including Fraud Protection Advanced, Chargeback Protection and Dispute Automation, which apply AI-driven risk models built on PayPal's global network data to protect merchant revenue while preserving approval rates; and (3) Crypto solutions for businesses, where applicable; 4) Braintree solution and local payment methods where available 5) ability to consult on holistic payment solutions beyond the PayPal checkout button.

Success is measured by profitable activated volume within assigned markets and verticals.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Managers to identify, shape, and advance PSC opportunities for new and existing accounts across the Region.
  • Lead deeper discovery, solution design, competitive positioning, and pricing construction on qualified opportunities.
  • Design and position the right combination of PayPal capabilities across Payouts, RaaS and Crypto, not a single product in isolation, and translate it into a client-specific business case with quantified value against competitive alternatives.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities that require sound judgment and an understanding of current market, regulatory and business trends.
  • Carry the target for the opportunities you develop or advance.
  • Use sales pipeline, back-book portfolio data, and product and merchant performance data to prioritize opportunities, build the commercial case, and support pricing decisions, treating data as the basis for prioritization, not a supporting exhibit.
  • Leverage internal and external data to identify growth opportunities and build pipeline.
  • Act as a force multiplier for Account Managers and other sellers, sharing PSC product knowledge and ushering merchants from lead to live.
  • Build credibility with and mobilize Account Management, Solution Engineering, Integration Engineers, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Product without formal authority over those teams.
  • Partner with product-line specialists to share best practice and adapt playbooks to local requirements.
  • Own and evolve the specialist team's playbook and selling process for the local market
  • Collect feedback and recommendations from Account Managers and customers, and channel them back to Product and GTM teams to help shape future product roadmaps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience across two or more of the following: domestic and cross-border payouts and disbursements; transactional fraud, chargeback and dispute management; crypto or digital-asset solutions for businesses. Direct experience with PayPal's products is a bonus.

jobs.description_text:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This job drives accounting activities. You’ll lead multiple process workstreams through exploration, gap analysis, integration planning, execution, and problem-solving. Additionally, you’ll identify finance-related risks and collaborate with cross-functional teams to mitigate them, discuss finance and accounting concepts across the organization, and influence execution of plans through strong interpersonal skills. You’ll also proactively engage in resolving potential conflicts between Finance and non-Finance functions.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead several process workstreams through explorations, gap analysis, integration planning, execution, and problem solving
  • Identify finance-related risks and partner with cross-functional teams to mitigate the identified risks
  • Discuss finance/accounting concepts with others across the organization
  • Lead and drive execution of plans and influence where you do not have direct authority through strong interpersonal skills
  • Proactively engage, evaluate, and drive resolution of potential conflicts between various Finance and non-Finance functions
  • Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Work collaboratively with workstream leads and subject matter experts to arrive at risk-based approaches related to tactical execution steps
  • Comfort with problem solving and creative solutioning

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

The Manager, Finance – Credit Controllership & Financial Reporting, is a hands-on finance role responsible for the preparation, execution and review of accounting, close, financial reporting, and control activities for PayPal’s credit portfolio. This role provides strong financial stewardship over credit products and related transactions, including loan receivables, expected credit losses, fair-value and valuation adjustments, credit asset sales, ABS/securitisation activities and related balance-sheet and P&L reporting.

The role combines technical accounting expertise, operational execution, analytical review, and control discipline. It partners closely with Credit, Risk, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Regulatory Reporting, Global Controllership, and the Controllership CoE in India to ensure that credit activities are accurately reflected in the books and records, appropriately controlled and supported by robust documentation and audit evidence.

The successful candidate will be expected to challenge data, assumptions, and accounting outcomes, resolve issues end-to-end, and convert complex credit activity into clear financial reporting and management insight.


Key Responsibilities

1. Credit Controllership & Month-End Close

·      Own day-to-day finance execution for assigned credit portfolios, ensuring transactions are completely and accurately reflected in the general ledger and financial reporting.

·      Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, roll-forwards, accruals, reclassifications and close deliverables for credit-related balance sheet and P&L accounts.

·      Perform monthly close activities for credit products, including analysis of receivables, interest and fee income, credit losses, valuation movements, write-offs, and recoveries.

·      Investigate unusual movements, data breaks, and reconciliation differences; determine root causes and drive issues to resolution.

·      Prepare monthly management reporting and analytics that explain portfolio movements, financial performance, key drivers, and emerging risks.

2. Credit Products & Portfolio Accounting

·      Build and maintain a strong understanding of PayPal credit products, including consumer and merchant credit, revolving and instalment products, and portfolios originated, purchased, or sold by PayPal entities.

·      Execute and review accounting for credit asset purchases, transfers, sales, and related settlement flows, including assessment of balance-sheet presentation, gain/loss recognition and supporting reconciliations.

·      Support accounting for credit asset sales, forward-flow arrangements, ABS/securitisation structures and related funding or servicing arrangements, including preparation of transaction accounting papers and audit support.

·      Partner with Credit and Treasury to understand portfolio structure, contractual terms, funding arrangements and changes affecting accounting or reporting.

·       Maintain robust accounting documentation for significant and non-routine credit transactions and ensure conclusions are clearly supported by the applicable accounting framework.


3. ECL, Credit Losses & Valuation

·      Prepare, review, and challenge the financial reporting impact of expected credit loss (ECL) and related credit-loss estimates, including data, staging, model outputs, overlays, and management adjustments.

·      Coordinate with Credit Risk and Model teams to understand changes in PD, LGD, EAD, macroeconomic scenarios, calibration, and model methodology, and assess the financial reporting implications.

·      Perform analytical review of allowance movements, including originations, derecognitions, changes in credit risk, model changes, write-offs, and recoveries.

·      Support valuation and fair-value accounting for credit portfolios where applicable, including review of cash-flow forecasts, discount-rate assumptions, and valuation adjustments.

·      Ensure appropriate documentation of key judgments, estimates, sensitivities and management overlays for financial reporting and audit purposes.


4. Financial Reporting, IFRS / Local GAAP & Regulatory Requirements

·      Prepare and review financial statement and management reporting outputs relating to credit activities under IFRS, US GAAP and/or applicable local GAAP requirements, as relevant to the entity.

·      Prepare and maintain accounting bridges and reconciliations between local GAAP and IFRS where required.

·      Support statutory, prudential, and other regulatory reporting by providing accurate credit-related data, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

·      Monitor changes in accounting and regulatory requirements affecting credit products and translate them into practical actions for Finance and Business stakeholders.

·      Prepare technical accounting memos for significant credit transactions, new products, and changes in portfolio strategy.


5. Controls, Risk Management & Audit Readiness

·      Execute and evidence key financial controls over credit accounting, including reconciliations, review controls, data quality checks, and certification activities.

·      Identify control gaps, assess accounting and reporting risks, design practical remediation actions, and track issues through sustainable closure.

·      Maintain audit-ready support for credit balances, estimates, transaction accounting, and disclosures, including clear evidence trails and timely responses to auditor requests.

·      Work with Internal Audit, SOX, Risk, Compliance and external auditors on credit-related findings, testing, and remediation.

·      Ensure finance procedures and control documentation remain current as credit products, systems and processes evolve.


6. Partnership with the Controllership CoE in India

·      Work with the CoE as an execution partner for close, reconciliations, journal preparation, reporting packs, and control activities.

·      Provide clear priorities, accounting guidance, and quality expectations; review outputs and resolve exceptions rather than relying solely on high-level oversight.

·      Establish effective review routines, issue escalation, and service-level expectations across the end-to-end credit controllership process.

·      Drive standardisation, automation and process simplification across credit accounting and reporting activities.


7. Business & Cross-Functional Partnership

·      Partner with Credit, Risk, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Regulatory Reporting, Product and Operations teams on financial implications of credit initiatives.

·      Support new product launches, portfolio migrations, funding initiatives, and strategic transactions by identifying accounting, reporting, control, and data requirements early in the process.

·      Provide clear, concise financial analysis to management on portfolio trends, risks, accounting impacts, and execution priorities.

·      Influence across functions and geographies, including situations where the role does not have direct authority.


8. Continuous Improvement & Transformation

·      Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, quality, and resilience of credit close and reporting processes.

·      Use data queries, analytical tools and automation to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve the timeliness of financial insight.

·      Participate in ERP, data, reporting, and finance transformation initiatives affecting credit activities.

·      Develop repeatable documentation, dashboards and operating procedures that improve transparency and execution discipline.


Key Deliverables / Success Measures

·      Timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual close for assigned credit activities.

·      High-quality reconciliations with clear explanations and rapid resolution of exceptions.

·      Audit-ready support for ECL, valuation, credit asset sales, and securitization transactions.

·      Accurate and well-supported financial and regulatory reporting submissions.

·      Effective control execution with timely remediation of identified issues.

·      Improved automation, standardization, and use of data analytics across credit controllership.

·      Clear management insight into portfolio performance, financial impacts, and emerging risks.


Key Stakeholders

·      Finance Director / CFO and Global Controllership

·      Controllership CoE India

·      Credit Risk, Model Risk and Credit Operations

·      Treasury / Funding and Liquidity

·      FP&A and Tax

·      Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit and SOX

·      Regulatory Reporting and local Finance teams

·      Product and Business leaders

·      External auditors and other assurance providers


Required Qualifications

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline.

·      Typically, 8–10+ years of relevant experience in accounting, controllership, financial services, banking, or Big 4 audit, with meaningful exposure to credit products.

·      Strong technical accounting knowledge, with solid IFRS and/or US GAAP experience.

·      Practical experience with credit products, loan receivables, and credit-loss accounting; experience with ABS and securitisation is strongly preferred.

·      Experience with ECL / CECL concepts, valuation allowances, portfolio analytics, or related credit-estimation processes.

·      Strong Excel and data-analysis skills; experience with SAP/S4HANA or other ERP/reporting tools is an advantage.

·      Ability to analyse complex transactions, identify accounting and control implications and document conclusions clearly.

·      High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and ability to work effectively under close and reporting deadlines.

·       Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

·      ACCA, CPA, ACA, CIMA, or equivalent professional qualification.

·      Experience in regulated banking, payments, fintech, or other highly controlled financial services environments.

·      Experience working with geographically distributed teams or a Finance Center of Excellence.

·      Experience with credit asset sales, forward-flow arrangements, ABS/securitization, servicing, or structured finance transactions.

·      Experience with financial transformation, automation, data-querying, and process redes.

jobs.description_text:
About Virgin Media Ireland


Virgin Media Ireland is home to the country’s fastest broadband and is the leading provider of connected entertainment and broadcasting. We power millions of connections nationwide every single day, delivering award winning ultrafast broadband, TV, mobile and home phone services that keep Ireland working, streaming and communicating at superfast speed. Our Virgin Media Business division provides the fastest broadband speeds and advanced connectivity solutions for entrepreneurs, SMEs, large organisations and the public sector.

 

Virgin Media Television is Ireland’s number one commercial public service broadcaster, delivering four free‑to‑air channels - Virgin Media One, Virgin Media Two, Virgin Media Three and Virgin Media Four, along with Virgin Media Play, our state‑of‑the‑art free streaming service. We deliver fresh, diverse and original Irish content - from news and current affairs to entertainment, factual and drama - alongside the best of international programming.

 

Virgin Media Ireland is part of Liberty Global Ltd. (Nasdaq: LBTYA, LBTYB, LBTYK), a leading international converged connectivity and investment company. Liberty Global manages three complementary platforms: Liberty Telecom, which provides around 80 million fixed and mobile connections across Europe and generates $21.6 billion in aggregate revenue; Liberty Growth, which invests in scalable technology, media, sports and infrastructure businesses valued at $3.4 billion; and Liberty Services, which delivers technology, operational and financial services generating approximately $700 million annually*. Together, these platforms create long‑term, sustainable value for shareholders.

 

 For more information, visit www.virginmedia.ie.

 

 *As independently valued as of December 31, 2025.  

**Represents full year 2025 revenue of Liberty Services, substantially all of which is derived from our consolidated businesses and nonconsolidated joint ventures


About the Role:


Virgin Media Business operates in all business markets from small to medium enterprise, medium to large enterprise. Offering Irelands fastest broadband and a range of data, fixed voice, mobile, cloud and security solutions to keep our customers connected. This is great opportunity to join a fast-paced fun diverse team that love to build connections that really matter and have fun while doing it.


As an Senior Cyber Security Analyst in the Virgin Media Ireland Cyber Security Team to take responsibility for providing guidance and ensures Security, Governance, Risk and Technical Security Compliance across our IT and physical environments. This role requires a decision maker, someone who can build security risk models. It will also be operational and hands on, liaising with internal IT groups within Virgin Media Ireland and Liberty Global, as well leveraging external security expertise. You will be required to assess and assist in the enforcement of Information Security policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines based on knowledge of best practices and compliance requirements

Specific Duties & Tasks:


· Administer and monitor security solutions used within Virgin Media Ireland and provide key KPI’s to the business.

· Liaise with the various Virgin Media Ireland business units to ensure data protection policies are followed and all implemented business processes align with the company's security policies.

· Taking key decisions in compliance standards, control/governance and mitigation ensuring business units are ready for certification audits

· Manage security incidents, escalating where necessary to the Global Security group and ensuring Virgin Media senior leadership are fully informed

· Auditing of Virgin Media’s security capabilities, governance within functions and our compliance and industry recommendations

· Engaging with industry partners and providers with regards to leveraging current and emerging practices and tooling within the Security sector

· Provide security input into the design of the companies on-prem and cloud network architecture.

· Maintain, enhance, and contribute to the documentation around security tools, processes & procedures

· Own delivery of the company's wider information security strategy and data governance.

· Own IT Security’s input into risk and compliance programme initiatives such as GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC, NIST, etc.


Skills & Expertise:


· Have acquired or be in the process of acquiring a security certification E.G. CISA, CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+ or other security related technology certifications.

· Have acquired or be in the process of acquiring a security certification E.G. Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS or Google cloud certification.

· Have acquired or be in the process of acquiring a technical certification E.G. Cisco CCNA, Cisco CBROPS, Cisco CBRCOR, Cisco CBRFIR, Cisco SCOR, Cisco SVPN, Cisco SAUTO, FortiGate Essentials, FortiGate Security, FortiGate Infrastructure, FortiGate Enterprise Firewall technology certifications.

· Ability to implement Computer Hacking tools (ex. Pen-testing / Vulnerability Management, Reconnaissance)

· Prior experience with vulnerability & patch management programs and tools, change control and general IT governance processes.

· Possess Knowledge of Network protocols (ex. routing, switching, client/server communications, TCP/IP, OSI, Server Hardening).

· Must have broad understanding of IT infrastructure at a network, server, and endpoint level

· Must be experienced with cybersecurity controls including Firewalls, DDoS, IPS/IDS, URL Filtering, SIEM Solutions, Web Application Firewalls, multi-factor authentication, PKI’s Environment, anti-malware protections, anomaly detection, etc.

· Experience with mobility solutions including EDR, XDR, MDM, MAM, auto-enrolment, and BYOD.

· Must be experienced in solutions including identity management, Federation, ADFS, AD Connect, SAML, etc.

· Possess a good understanding of risk management, security architecture, common design flaws/weaknesses, and vulnerability analysis.

· Experience in administering security aspects of Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and Google Cloud tenancies, IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.

· Extensive understanding of Information security management best practices, including knowledge of policies and standards (ISO27001, NIST, 27005, 22301, SOX, SOC, CIS Framework PCI-DSS or equivalent)


The Person:

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work:

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values: 

Bold in how we dream and innovate

Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional in execution and impact


Proofpoint is looking for a proactive, responsible, highly motivated Professional Services Consultant to join our team in leading implementations of Proofpoint solutions and maintaining technical relationships with our enterprise customers.  

The role will demand interaction with large scale enterprises at senior levels, as well as with technical staff within the traditional IT organization.  This individual will engage directly with newly signed customers to implement Proofpoint solutions at their sites.  The successful candidate will have sound technical experience and skills, blended with strong interpersonal and communication skills.  They must be able to take responsibility and accept accountability for successful customer engagements and partner technical relationships.

This is a highly technical role and deep knowledge of the Linux operating systems and network configuration is required, as well as a strong background in email. Resolving customer issues routinely includes working in complex product and infrastructure configurations, problem troubleshooting and isolation, performance tuning and optimization, training the customers on product features, escalating product defects and issues and driving them towards resolution while managing the customer.

 

Your Day-to-Day


  • Lead implementations and consultative engagements for Proofpoint Email Security and/or Data Security solutions, including installation, configuration, customization, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
  • Scope customer engagements by assessing technical environments, operations, and business processes; gathering requirements; and recommending solutions that optimize Proofpoint technologies.
  • Provide technical and strategic guidance to help customers protect their people, email environments, identities, and sensitive data.
  • Develop solution designs, implementation approaches, best practices, and, where appropriate, proofs of concept.
  • Troubleshoot complex product, infrastructure, messaging, data security, and network configurations and drive technical issues through to resolution.
  • Deliver technical workshops and training to customers and partners.
  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Coordinate across Professional Services, Support, Engineering, Product, Sales, and other internal teams to address customer requirements and manage escalations.
  • Act as a strong voice for customers internally, providing feedback that helps improve Proofpoint products and customer deployment experiences.
  • Present project updates, risks, challenges, and recommended solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Define and document best practices, processes, templates, and reference architectures for use across the broader organization.
  • Continue developing technical expertise across Proofpoint's Email and Data Security portfolio, expanding beyond your primary area of expertise.

What You Bring to the Team

  • Professional fluency in German and English is mandatory.
  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Professional Services, IT Consulting, Sales Engineering, or Technical Support.
  • Strong technical experience in email/messaging, data security, DLP, endpoint, cloud, or identity security.
  • Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure and technologies such as SMTP, HTTP, LDAP, TCP/IP, Linux/UNIX, networking, Active Directory, and Entra ID.
