Role Summary


Discovery, Preclinical, and Translational Solutions (DP&TS) sits at the center of Pfizer’s scientific software work, building the digital tools that help researchers move from target identification through clinical translation.

We’re looking for a Solution Engineer to own data storage and registration for integrative biology research. This is a hands-on role: you’ll design, build, and maintain the capabilities that determine how biological research data gets stored, registered, and accessed. You’ll partner with the aligned capability lead to scope and prioritize what gets built, and work across scientific, product, and engineering stakeholders to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and useful for researchers.

 

You’ll work hands-on in AWS and GCP, building storage and data services that span both clouds and hold large omics datasets (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, imaging). You’ll need depth in large-scale data management and cross-cloud integration, plus enough scientific fluency to earn credibility with computational biologists and engineers alike.

 

Reporting to the Principal Engineer, Integrative Biology Solutions, you’ll define the technical direction for data storage and registration within the Integrative Biology space, aligning with scientific strategy, regulatory requirements, and enterprise architecture. You’re expected to be hands-on writing and reviewing real code, not just directing while also setting the standards and patterns that guide contractors and cross-functional teams. You’ll lead contractor teams as needed to extend capacity.

 

You’re the primary technical owner: individual engineering depth combined with cross-functional leadership. The problems are real, large-scale, heterogeneous scientific data with strict regulatory requirements, and the solutions need to hold up at research scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and Lead Data Storage and Registration Solutions: own data storage and registration end-to-end: design, implementation, and maintenance. Work with the Capability Lead to prioritize and scope features. Lead contractors as needed to extend capacity.
  • Oversee Data Storage, Registration, and Scientific Data Stewardship: design and implement scalable data storage, experiment registration, metadata, provenance, lineage, access control, and findability capabilities. Set the storage, metadata, and stewardship standards that make Integrative Biology omics data trustworthy, reusable, and AI-ready across AWS and GCP.
  • Define Standards and Best Practices: establish and maintain standards, architectural patterns, and governance frameworks for the capability area. Get them documented and adopted by delivery teams and contractors.
  • Collaborate with Capability Lead and Business Stakeholders: work closely with the R&D capability lead to understand business needs, translate scientific requirements into technical solutions, and keep the backlog prioritized. Be the technical partner scientists and product stakeholders can rely on.
  • Lead Contractor Teams and Drive Delivery: direct contractors as needed: provide technical guidance, review their work, and hold the line on quality, scope, and timelines.
  • Provide Technical Guidance and Architecture Leadership: make and document key technical decisions, review designs and implementations, and guide technical direction for contractors and cross-functional partners in the capability area.
  • Drive Innovation, Continuous Improvement, and Operational Excellence: identify and address technical debt, performance issues, and security gaps. Keep the platform moving forward in line with changing research and business needs.
  • Solve Highly Complex and Cross-Disciplinary Problems: solve complex data engineering and storage challenges: large-scale heterogeneous scientific data, demanding research workflows, and the compliance requirements that come with a regulated environment.
  • Build and Operate Cross-Cloud Storage and Data Services: design and implement storage, registration, and data access capabilities across AWS and GCP. Own identity federation, network connectivity, data movement, and replication between clouds so researchers can work with data where it lives without duplicating it.
  • Manage Data Lifecycle, Performance, and Cost at Scale: define storage tiering, retention, archival, and egress policies for very large omics datasets. Monitor storage and transfer costs and tune for throughput on high-volume analytical and pipeline workloads.

Basic Qualifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or related discipline)


Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, data engineering, or solution engineering roles, with demonstrated hands-on delivery of complex data storage, registration, or related platform capabilities.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining data storage and registration solutions in a scientific or regulated enterprise environment, including hands-on implementation accountability.
  • Experience defining standards, best practices, and technical patterns within a capability or domain area, and driving their adoption across delivery teams.
  • Strong technical background in data engineering, cloud-native platforms, and software development, with the ability to contribute individually and lead contractor teams toward delivery outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating storage and data services in both AWS and GCP, including at least one production system that integrates data or services across the two clouds.
  • Experience managing very large scientific or research datasets (hundreds of terabytes to petabytes), including tiering, lifecycle management, performance tuning, and cost control.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Python, Typescript, Java, or other modern high-level language
  • Expertise in infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Helm) and CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • AWS: S3 (including storage classes and Glacier), IAM, Lake Formation, Glue, Athena, and high-throughput file storage such as FSx for Lustre.
  • GCP: Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Dataproc or Dataflow, IAM and Workload Identity Federation, and VPC Service Controls.
  • Cross-cloud integration: identity federation between AWS and GCP, private connectivity (Direct Connect, Cloud Interconnect, Cross-Cloud Interconnect), data transfer and replication tooling (e.g., Storage Transfer Service, DataSync), and egress cost management.
  • Modern data architectures: lakehouse patterns and open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) that work across cloud engines.
  • Omics data: working knowledge of common formats (FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, Parquet, HDF5/AnnData, Zarr) and how their size and access patterns affect storage design.

 

Other Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience in working with regulated data, compliance frameworks, and secure development practices
  • Ability to lead complex engineering efforts across global, cross-functional teams
  • Fluent in English; capable of clear technical communication across scientific and engineering disciplines

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

Education: Master’s or PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or related discipline)

 

Domain Expertise

  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical R&D, life sciences, or computational biology
  • Familiarity with GA4GH standards for omics data (DRS, htsget, refget, Passports) and FAIR data principles
  • Experience with scientific workflow platforms such as Nextflow, Snakemake, AWS HealthOmics, or Google Cloud Batch.
  • AWS or GCP professional-level certifications, such as Solutions Architect Professional or Professional Cloud Architect.

 

Technical Leadership

  • Recognized internal or external technical thought leadership in integrative biology, omics data ecosystems, computational research environments, AI-ready data products, or scientific analytics capabilities
  • Experience directing contractor teams or vendor resources on technical delivery, including providing technical guidance, reviewing work, and maintaining quality standards

Strategic Capabilities

  • Familiarity with research environments and how data scientists and computational biologists work, including their tooling preferences and data workflows
  • Experience working with large volumes of scientific or research data, including understanding the technical challenges of data at scale (performance, storage costs, data quality, heterogeneous formats, findability)

Travel Requirements

  • Travel up to 10% may be required for business activities.

 
Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Unlock Your Potential at Abbott

Abbott in Ireland

Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.


About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.


Abbott Diagnostics Ireland – Longford & Sligo

Abbott Diagnostics is a global leader in in vitro diagnostics, delivering innovative testing solutions that help improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our Longford and Sligo sites play critical roles in supporting the growing global demand for diagnostic testing across areas including infectious disease, cancer, thyroid, and cardiovascular care. Together, these locations contribute to the development and manufacture of technologies that advance modern healthcare, while offering employees the opportunity to build rewarding careers in thriving regional communities across Ireland.


Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company.


We currently have a position for Operations Technology (OT) Engineering Lead in our Diagnostics Division Engineering Team and this role will involve the following:


Role Purpose

The Operations Technology (OT) Engineering Lead will provide enterprise leadership for Operational Technology, Smart Factory, and Digital Manufacturing initiatives across the global manufacturing network.

This role will define and execute the strategy, standards, and technology roadmap required to accelerate digital transformation, enabling the integration of automation, data, analytics, and AI to improve manufacturing performance, quality, compliance, and business value. The position will drive the standardization and scaling of digital manufacturing capabilities across sites, ensuring the organization realizes maximum value from its technology investments.


Key Responsibilities

·        Develop and lead the global OT and Smart Factory strategy aligned to business objectives.

·        Establish enterprise standards, governance, and architecture for digital manufacturing solutions.

·        Drive the deployment and scaling of Operational Technology, automation, MES, SCADA, Industrial IoT, and intelligent factory capabilities across manufacturing sites.

·        Enable secure integration of manufacturing systems with enterprise platforms and data ecosystems.

·        Ensure compliance with regulatory, quality, data integrity, and cybersecurity requirements.

·        Identify and deliver high-impact digital manufacturing initiatives that improve operational performance, productivity, quality, and resilience.

·        Partner with site, divisional, and functional leaders to drive adoption and value realization.

·        Build organizational capability through technical leadership, coaching, and development of OT engineering best practices.


Strategic Impact

This role will:

·        Accelerate the organization's Intelligent Factory vision through scalable digital manufacturing solutions.

·        Standardize OT and Smart Factory approaches across the manufacturing network.

·        Improve operational performance through enhanced connectivity, visibility, analytics, and automation.

·        Enable enterprise-wide adoption of AI-enabled manufacturing insights and decision-making.

·        Reduce duplication of effort and improve return on technology investments.


Key Measures of Success

·        Deployment and scaling of Smart Factory solutions across multiple sites.

·        Adoption of standardized OT governance and technology frameworks.

·        Improvements in OEE, productivity, quality, and manufacturing performance.

·        Delivery of measurable cost savings and operational efficiencies.

·        Increased utilization of manufacturing data and digital technologies to drive business outcomes.

jobs.title: Sr Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Your work days are brighter here.


We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


About the Team


Workday Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, Compliance & Trust team builds and sustains trust in Workday's cybersecurity commitments by embedding a cybersecurity-first mindset, delivering cybersecurity assurance and enabling business growth. We act as trusted advisors and change agents across Workday to protect the data of our fellow Workmates and 8000+ customers.

Workday is paving the road forward with how we build, package, deploy and secure our tools and services. We're using the latest technologies to build platforms and services to support our growth while also ensuring the protection of Workday data and infrastructure is paramount.

About the Role


The Senior CyberSecurity Engineer is a key technical leader responsible for defining and driving the strategic direction and implementation of security controls across the organization's infrastructure. This role requires deep technical expertise in infrastructure security and strong coding/automation skills to industrialize compliance and security processes. The Senior Engineer is expected to lead complex projects, mentor junior staff, and significantly influence security governance decisions.


Responsibilities include: 

  • Champion the principle of translating security policies directly into testable, automated code to ensure non-bypassable compliance.
  • Design and execute the roadmap for industrializing and automating security governance, compliance verification, and control enforcement across the organization.
  • Drive the adoption of DevSecOps principles by embedding security controls directly into the CI/CD pipeline and contributing secure, reusable modules (e.g., secure Terraform/CloudFormation modules) for engineering teams.

About You


Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in engineering, with a strong emphasis on security architecture, leading complex security initiatives, and developing advanced security solutions with 2+ years focused on security governance/compliance.
  • Extensive and deep hands-on experience architecting, implementing, and securing infrastructure and services within major cloud service providers (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) at scale.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Go, Bash, Ruby) with the ability to develop automation for security operations, configuration management, and compliance.
  • Expert-level understanding and practical application of cloud security concepts, principles, architectures, and technologies, with a proven track record of designing and implementing robust, enterprise-grade security controls in complex, multi-cloud environments.
  • A deep, expert-level understanding of network, application, and platform security, including advanced threat landscapes, attack vectors, and mitigation techniques.
  • Proven experience in architecting, implementing, and evangelizing secure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices and automation at scale using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.



Other Qualifications:

  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)) or equivalent focused training.
  • Proven experience implementing, auditing, and maintaining controls for major compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001).
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and align senior leadership, diverse engineering teams, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex technical security problems and propose pragmatic, business-enabling solutions.
  • Ability to lead technical security initiatives end-to-end, from conceptual design through successful implementation.
  • Exceptional ability to communicate highly technical security risks and compliance requirements into clear, quantitative business terms for executive leadership.

Listed below is the base salary range applicable to this position. Workday pay ranges (and the precise pay offered to the successful candidate) are based on a number of objective criteria such as relevant experience and skills, and educational qualifications, level of responsibility, demands of the role, work location and business need. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

 

Primary Location Base Pay Range: €84,000 EUR - €126,000 EUR Ireland

 

 

Our Approach to Flexible Work
 

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.


Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.


Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.


Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.


If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.



Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!

Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast-paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.

Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday, and enjoy the reward of helping customers solve problems, learn about new features, and find greater value in their Workday investment.   • Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
  • Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips & tricks.
  • Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
  • Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
  • Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
  • Providing one-on-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
  • Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
  • Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
  • Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
  • Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption.

In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other Customer Enablement services, such as:

  • Office Hours to conduct appointment-based consulting engagements providing guidance and product expertise to customers
  • Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
  • Provide one-on-one customer configuration designs
  • Deployments including full deployment of Workday features

About You


Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of proven ability building and maintaining Prism Analytics
  • 3+ years of proven ability building and maintaining Workday HCM/Financial Reporting & Analytics
  • 5+ years of HCM Reporting, Analytics, and Data warehousing experience for enterprise software applications
  • 3+ years of IT implementation experience
  • 3+ years of software consulting experience

Additional Qualifications:

  • Workday Certification or ability to certify in Prism Analytics and at least one of the following: Workday HCM, Workday Financial, Workday Reporting
  • Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
  • Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
  • Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously
  • Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required. Advanced degree preferred

jobs.title: Associate Director, External Manufacturing (Integrated Launch Excellence)
jobs.description_text:
Job Description

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Associate Director to join our Integrated Launch Excellence team. This role supports API external manufacturing operations primarily in Italy and Spain.

 

The successful candidate will play a crucial role in project management, tech transfer and launch activities for new products, collaborating closely with internal and external stakeholders throughout all project phases.

 

If you are passionate about making a difference in the biopharmaceutical industry and have the relevant experience, we encourage you to apply.

 

Bring energy, knowledge, innovation to carry out the following:

 

  • Manage the introduction of new APIs into third-party manufacturers in the EU region (Italy and Spain), making a significant impact on our global reach
  • Develop and oversee the new product introduction project plan with third parties to ensure we meet launch timelines and delight our customers
  • Coordinate our company’s cross-functional project team and collaborate with third parties through all project phases to ensure seamless execution
  • You'll handle operational project details with third-party project managers, including materials readiness, documentation, Person-In-Plant (PIP) planning and logistics
  • Support Person-In-Plant (PIP) activities as needed, playing a crucial role in our process verification
  • Conduct stage-gate reviews with management for our company’s cross-functional project team, providing vital updates and insights
  • Manage scope changes, evaluate impacts, communicate and obtain endorsements for proposed changes, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned
  • Coordinate risk management processes and handle event management, including impact assessment and response coordination, to mitigate project risks
  • Lead After Action Reviews to identify improvements and monitor completion of actions for future projects, fostering a culture of continuous improvement
  • Oversee post-PPQ manufacturing to ensure sustained supply and maintain 100% compliance in quality, environment, health and safety, upholding our high standards

 

 

What skills you will need:

In order to excel in this role, you will more than likely have:

 

  • Required:
  • A Bachelor’s degree in engineering, chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences or a related field
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) manufacturing (Operations and/or Technology), showing your expertise and depth of knowledge

 

  • Preferred:
  • Proven skills and expertise in the manufacture of APIs
  • Experience in managing a complex portfolio of projects, particularly new product introductions/technical transfers, which will showcase your exceptional project management skills
  • A deep understanding of GMP and EHS compliance and compliance risk, ensuring all operations meet our stringent standards
  • Lean Six Sigma & MPS experience to drive excellence in our processes
  • The ability to apply economic, financial, and industry data to make business decisions that drive value, highlighting your strategic mindset
  • Accomplishment-oriented, self-motivated and persistent traits that propel you towards success and inspire your team

  • Travel requirement:
  • Travel may be a requirement of this position up to 25-50%

 

 

We keep the patient at the very heart of all that we do and strive to find solutions and treatments for some of the world's most challenging healthcare needs.

 

As an equal opportunity employer, we are proud to be a company that embraces the value of bringing diverse, talented, and committed people together. Please don't hesitate to contact the Talent Acquisition Advisor assigned to this role should you need any support during our recruitment process.

 

We are committed to flexible working where possible, and this is why our Company has introduced a new hybrid working model for office-based colleagues around the world.

Please feel free to speak to us about what flexibility means to you during your application.

 

So, if you are ready to:

Invent solutions to meet unmet healthcare needs, please apply today.

API Development, Drug Product Development, Lean Six Sigma (LSS), Manufacturing, New Product Introduction (NPI), Operational Excellence (OpEx), Project Management, Technical Transfer

jobs.title: Director, Decision Experience
jobs.description_text:
Job Description

Digital is the multiplier that will allow Development Sciences and Clinical Supply (DSCS) to deliver better experiments faster, support efficient filing and launch, strengthen supply chains and enable higher-confidence decisions across the portfolio. The DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) organization pioneers and deploys digital technologies that improve the acquisition, automation and use of data to enhance insight, efficiency and quality across DSCS processes and methods.

The Director, Decision Experience is a senior leader within the Decision Intelligence team responsible for defining how leaders, scientists and operational teams interact with data, analytics, predictive models and intelligent or agentic capabilities to make decisions. The role translates scientific and business decision needs into human-centered decision journeys and usable digital experiences, with particular emphasis on embedding AI-enabled assistance into the user experience.

This role serves as the primary Decision Intelligence integration point with the broader DSCS organization. The Director connects business context and domain knowledge with technology capabilities to create decision products that are understandable, trusted, and adopted to deliver measurable business outcomes. Anchor use cases include pipeline prioritization (helping leaders sequence and trade off programs based on value, probability of success, timelines and strategic fit) and pipeline resource modeling (forecasting demand on people, laboratory, equipment and clinical supply capacity across the portfolio and testing scenarios before committing resources).


The Director, Decision Experience will:

·   Define the strategy, roadmap and reusable patterns for AI-enabled decision experiences across the Decision Intelligence portfolio.

·   Design human-centered decision journeys that quantify decisions, evidence, options, uncertainty, trade-offs and recommendations.

·   Serve as the Decision Intelligence integration point with the DSCS organization, translating domain context and decision needs into mathematical frameworks for quantifying decision outcomes to support next-best-action recommendation.

·   Identify prioritized Decision Intelligence use cases, workflows and experience requirements. This includes leading the design of decision experiences for strategic options assessment across the pipeline, enabling leaders to compare programs, quantify capacity constraints and trade-offs, and test "what-if" scenarios before committing resources and capacity.

·   Partner with Agentic Intelligence to embed agentic assistance into user experiences for decision framing and outcome quantification, with appropriate human oversight, transparency, feedback and escalation.

·   Define and monitor measures of adoption, usability, trust, decision-cycle performance and business or scientific value of Decision Intelligence capabilities.

·   Advance the Decision Intelligence roadmap through scalable decision patterns, shared experience standards and continuous learning from users and outcomes.


Primary Activities

Decision Experience Strategy & Design: Define the experience, vision and sequenced roadmap for Decision Intelligence products. Identify the consequential decisions to support and clarify the decision-maker, required context, options, constraints, trade-offs, evidence and decision rights. Design end-to-end journeys that connect governed data, analytics, predictive insight, scenarios, scientific knowledge and intelligent assistance within coherent workflows.

Strategic Options Assessment: Partner with DSCS portfolio, functional and operational leaders to define the decision logic, criteria and data needed to prioritize investments in pipeline programs, including demand forecasting. Translate prioritization drivers (probability of success, timeline, strategic alignment) and investments (FTE, laboratory and equipment capacity, materials and clinical supply) into transparent, quantitative frameworks. Design experiences that surface capacity gaps, bottlenecks and conflicts, allow users to run scenarios such as program acceleration, delay, addition or termination, and show the downstream effect on timelines and resources. Ensure assumptions, uncertainty and sensitivity are visible so prioritization decisions are explainable, repeatable and defensible in governance forums. Decision authority stays with accountable portfolio leaders.

AI Integration into the User Experience: Translate decision needs into interaction and experience requirements for intelligent assistance, conversational experiences, recommendations, scenario exploration, exception management and workflow orchestration. Partner with Agentic Intelligence to determine where AI should inform, assist, challenge, recommend, monitor or initiate action. Define human-in-the-loop checkpoints, explanations, feedback mechanisms and escalation paths.

Business Integration & Partnership: Establish trusted partnerships with DSCS functional areas and domain experts. Discover and articulate business questions, workflows, terminology, evidence requirements, constraints and adoption barriers. Translate business context into quantitative decision frameworks, ensuring DSCS subject matter experts remain engaged through discovery, design, validation, implementation and continuous improvement.

Requirements Translation & Product Definition: Convert complex processes into decision maps, future-state workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes. Maintain a clear line of sight from the decision to the supporting systems, data, analytics and agents.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Coordinate contributions within cross-functional teams building Decision Intelligence capabilities. Maintain clarity on outcomes, ownership, dependencies, trade-offs, risks and decisions. Escalate risks or issues to the appropriate governance forums.

Reusable Decision Patterns & Design System: Develop reusable approaches for decision framing, uncertainty and outcome quantification, scenario analysis, recommendation presentation and explanation, approvals and feedback. Promote consistency and reuse across decision products while allowing appropriate domain-specific design.

Adoption, Value Realization & Continuous Learning: Define product-specific success measures including adoption, user experience, cycle-time improvement, decision consistency and evidence of improved decision quality. For pipeline decisions, this includes faster portfolio-review cycles, accurate demand forecasts compared with actuals, proactive identification of capacity conflicts and fewer reprioritizations..

Responsible AI & Decision Governance: Embed requirements for transparency, traceability, data quality, human oversight, security, privacy and compliance into the decision experience. Ensure relevant evidence, assumptions, provenance, uncertainty and limitations are visible to users and that decision authority remains with accountable domain leaders.


Required Skills and Qualifications

·   Experience: 8+ years of experience in digital product leadership, decision support, user experience, business analysis, analytics, AI-enabled solutions, scientific technology or a related field, including demonstrated leadership of complex cross-functional initiatives.

·   Business Translation: Demonstrated ability to understand scientific or technical workflows and translate them into usable decision products, experience requirements, process designs and measurable outcomes.

·   Predictive Analytics: Experience with predictive analytics, scenario analysis, optimization (e.g., constrained resource allocation or portfolio optimization), demand forecasting, conversational interfaces and/or agentic workflows.

·   Decision and Experience Design: Experience with human-centered design, product discovery, journey mapping, service design, process mapping, prototyping, user research, usability testing or comparable methods.

·   AI-Enabled Decision Support: Practical understanding of AI-enabled decision support and human-AI interaction, including human oversight, transparency, explainability, trust, feedback and responsible use.

·   Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to lead through influence across scientific, business and technology stakeholders in a complex matrix organization.

·   Product and Delivery Acumen: Experience converting ambiguous needs into a quantitative framework, with appropriate user stories and acceptance criteria. Agile project management or leadership experience is preferred.

·   Value Realization: Experience defining and monitoring adoption, usability and value, including decision-quality, and using evidence to guide continuous improvement.

·   Communication: Excellent written, verbal, facilitation and executive-communication skills, with the ability to make complex scientific and technical concepts clear to diverse audiences.

·   Regulated Environment: Familiarity with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, manufacturing, clinical supply or another regulated scientific environment, including relevant quality, data-integrity, privacy or compliance expectations.


Education and Skills

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, engineering, human factors, design, data or analytics, computer science, business, operations or a related field required. Advanced degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred.

Preferred Experience and Skills

·   Experience in pharmaceutical research and development, CMC, development sciences, manufacturing, clinical supply or laboratory sciences.

·   Experience with predictive analytics, scenario analysis, optimization, conversational interfaces or agentic workflows.

·   Familiarity with modern data and AI ecosystems and DevOps tools such as Databricks, GitHub, VSCode, Copilot Studio, custom web applications (e.g. React) or comparable enterprise capabilities.

·   Experience establishing design systems, interaction standards, product operating models or reusable digital patterns.

·   Experience working across organizational boundaries to connect scientific and/or business domain expertise with data, AI, product and UX capabilities.

An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, government requirements, and business or organizational needs. The successful candidate will be eligible for annual bonus and long-term incentive, if applicable.We offer a comprehensive package of benefits. jobs.title: Associate Director API Technology Portfolio Management
jobs.description_text:
Job Description

Shape the future of our global API supply by leading complex technology transfers, supplier partnerships and commercialization projects from sourcing through sustained supply.


For our Animal Health organization, we are currently recruiting an Associate Director API Technology Portfolio Management

Please note: this role is supported by a project budget secured through the end of 2028.

 

Welcome to our team

Our API Technology Group is a global team of technical experts supporting the development, commercialization and reliable supply of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for our Animal Health portfolio. Working closely with R&D, External Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain and Procurement, the team provides technical leadership across the API lifecycle, including sourcing, technology transfer, process optimization, supplier technical management and ongoing supply support. Through close partnership with internal and external manufacturing organizations, we help ensure a robust, compliant and reliable global API supply chain.

 

About the role

Reporting into the API Technology Europe & US Lead, you will provide technical and project leadership across a portfolio of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) projects and supply nodes, with a primary focus on activities across Europe and the United States. You will have end-to-end responsibility for projects ranging from API sourcing and technical transfer through scale-up, validation, commercialization and ongoing supply. Operating in a highly international and cross-functional environment, you will act as a key technical interface between our internal manufacturing sites, external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and functions such as R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain and Procurement. Combining strong technical expertise with project leadership and stakeholder management, you will help establish robust manufacturing processes, resolve complex technical challenges and ensure a reliable, compliant and competitive API supply.

 

This position can be based in: Boxmeer (NL), Unterschleissheim, Friesoythe (D), Dublin (Ie).

 

Main tasks and responsibilities

  • Lead a portfolio of API projects and supply nodes, taking ownership from sourcing and supplier selection through technical transfer, scale-up, validation, registration, commercialization and routine supply.
  • Lead the technical aspects of API sourcing and supplier selection, including defining technical requirements, conducting technical due diligence and assessing supplier capabilities and risks.
  • Drive technical transfer and commercialization activities by developing and managing integrated project plans, schedules, budgets and supplier deliverables in close collaboration with Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, R&D and manufacturing sites.
  • Provide technical leadership for assigned external suppliers and APIs, monitoring technical performance and leading cross-functional discussions on changes, deviations, investigations and improvement activities.
  • Lead the assessment and implementation of process and supplier changes, ensuring alignment across relevant functions and providing technical input for regulatory submissions, responses and commitments.
  • Identify and manage technical risks related to areas such as process chemistry, process capability, equipment, scale-up, material attributes and chemical comparability, and lead troubleshooting and investigations where necessary.
  • Act as a key technical interface for internal manufacturing sites and CMOs, translating supply requirements, deviations, complaints, changes and technical challenges into clear actions and project plans.
  • Maintain and strengthen API process and product knowledge, ensuring appropriate technical documentation, project records and knowledge management while clearly communicating progress, decisions, dependencies and risks through governance forums.
  • Drive continuous improvement across the API supply network, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, quality, cost, capacity, sustainability and overall process capability.
  • Visit external suppliers and manufacturing sites as required to support due diligence, technical reviews, investigations, troubleshooting and targeted audits, while also leading broader initiatives or portfolio activities as assigned.

 

Your profile

·       Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific or engineering discipline.

·       Strong, broad and relevant experience within the pharmaceutical, human health or animal health industry, working in a cGMP-regulated environment.

·       Strong technical knowledge of API development and manufacturing, with experience in areas such as process development, scale-up, process characterization, technical transfer, commercialization, manufacturing and lifecycle management.

·       Demonstrated experience working with external manufacturers and suppliers, including technical assessment, supplier selection, API sourcing and management of technical risks.

·       Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through execution, balancing technical requirements, supply continuity, quality, timelines and business priorities.

·       Strong experience in technical problem-solving and process improvement, including troubleshooting manufacturing issues, investigations and implementation of sustainable technical solutions.

·       Understanding of the regulatory requirements associated with API manufacturing, with experience providing technical input to regulatory submissions, responses, change assessments and commitments.

jobs.title: Product Technical Lead – Process Technology Transfer & Knowledge Management
jobs.description_text:
Job Description

We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. At the forefront of research, our company delivers innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. Join us as a Product Technical Lead and play a pivotal role in advancing our digital Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) strategy, connecting drug discovery and development to commercial manufacturing operations – a declared strategic priority for the company.


The Product Technical Lead – Process Technology Transfer & Knowledge Management is a technical leadership role responsible for advancing our digital Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) strategy.

This role establishes and executes the digital continuum connecting drug discovery and development within our Research & Development Division to commercial manufacturing operations across internal manufacturing sites and external partner networks, including our Manufacturing Division and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs).


Operating as the principal technical authority in this space, the Product Technical Lead drives the development of capabilities that enable scientists and engineers to:

  • Digitize process definitions.
  • Establish structured Process Knowledge Management (PKM) frameworks.
  • Maintain standardized, modular product structures.

These capabilities provide the foundation for:

  • ISA-88 and ISA-95 aligned digital recipes.
  • Streamlined receiving-site technology transfer readiness.
  • Automated configuration of shop floor execution systems.

In addition, the Product Technical Lead designs end-to-end data flows and technical integrations across manufacturing, laboratory, and enterprise systems, including Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Distributed Control Systems (DCS), ERP platforms, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), and enterprise data platforms. The role also a key stakeholder for establishingestablishes master data governance, semantic ontologies, and technical readiness for emerging artificial intelligence and predictive analytics capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the technical product roadmap for Digital Technology Transfer and Process Knowledge Management (PKM), translating scientific, engineering, and manufacturing business requirements into scalable, GxP-compliant digital solutions.
  • Drive the digitalization of recipe lifecycles, enabling the transition from developmentlaboratory process definitions to modular, ISA-88 and ISA-95 aligned digital recipes that reduce technology transfer cycle times and enhance Right-First Time (RFT) execution.
  • Champion technical excellence, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) rigor, Computer System Validation (CSV/CSA), GAMP 5 compliance, and data integrity (ALCOA+) across all product capabilities and releases.
  • Architect and oversee robust system integrations connecting Process Knowledge Management platforms with core manufacturing and enterprise systems, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms, Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Establish technical standards and governance for recipe master data, process parameters, and critical quality attributes (CQAs/CPPs), enabling seamless data exchange across internal manufacturing sites and external manufacturing partners.
  • Support Launch Preparedness and New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives by mapping current-state and future-state digital workflows, identifying capability gaps, and driving technology adoption.
  • Lead through influence within an Agile and SAFe product delivery frameworkframeworks while partnering with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Solution Architects, and site technical teams to prioritize backlogs based on business value and operational risk.
  • Build and guide a standardized technical delivery model for core product constructs, including generic master recipes, equipment models, parameter templates, and system interfaces.
  • Leverage global software engineering resources and managed service partners to accelerate delivery and operational excellence.
  • Partner with strategic automation and software vendors to align vendor roadmaps with the organization’s enterprise technical vision, validation strategy, and interoperability requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with adjacent digital product teams and strategic programs across our Manufacturing Division and our Research & Development Division to ensure architectural alignment and integrated execution.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
  • Minimum of six (6eight (8) years of progressive experience in biopharmaceutical process engineering, manufacturing automation, or life sciences digital product delivery.
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in biopharmaceutical or pharmaceutical technology transfer, process development, Manufacturing Sciences and Technology (MSAT), or manufacturing execution within a regulated GxP environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of ISA-88 and ISA-95 standards, process control systems, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, and Process Knowledge Management (PKM) platforms.
  • Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence multidisciplinary stakeholders across research, development, and manufacturing organizations, and drive alignment without direct reporting authority.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing technical scope, deliverables, and timelines within Agile (Scrum/SAFe) or structured SDLC environments.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical and architectural concepts effectively to executive leadership, technical teams, and manufacturing operations personnel.

Preferred

Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

  • Hands-on experience with Process Knowledge Management (PKM) platforms and digital recipe authoring or transformation tools.
  • Familiarity with receiving-site readiness assessments, facility fit evaluations, and external manufacturing technology transfer processes.
  • Practical experience with modern cloud data architectures and API-driven system integrations.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt) and/or Agile certifications such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or SAFe Practitioner.
  •

Job Description

The Global Pricing Team is charged with implementing and optimizing prices in the markets that ensure the long-term viability of the business, together with the development of solutions to accelerate patients’ access to our medicines. We act as both educators and advocates for our products, processes, and practices that help us revolutionize how our medicines create value in society. 

 

The successful candidate will: provide strategic pricing support to senior Regional Management within Eastern European and Middle East and Africa regions. Represent the countries’ perspectives from the assigned region for pricing strategies and activities on the basis of the economic, competitive and regulatory realities of the region. Educates subsidiaries on pricing theory and strategic operating procedures and advise on the implementation of pricing strategies. Identify and assessing intra-regional price trends and government activities that could impact our Company's long-term profitability.  Seek opportunities to maximize profitability by assisting local stakeholders in the development of solutions to emerging issues. The role can also be based in Europe.

 

Scope of Responsibilities:

 

Price Approval Process: Manages pricing proposals and their corresponding approvals for the entire portfolio of Company products in the assigned region. On the basis of sound business judgement and understanding of the market context will assess price proposals, formulate the business case and develops recommendations to approve, amend or reject price proposals.

 

Present and advocate recommendation to key stakeholders including Regional Presidents, Global Brand Leaders, Global Pricing Leadership Team and others as necessary.

 

Analytics: Generates analytics to support relevant stakeholders with price referencing impacts, launch price determination, contract development and other commercial efforts as needed.

 

More importantly, the person will focus on Price Planning and Mitigation.The person will take an active role in the identification, planning and execution of mitigation activities as determined by the Price Plan, including:


  • Proactive identification and characterization of cross-regional reference risks.
  • Development and implementation of price erosion mitigation actions in collaboration with Regional Pricing Leads and Regional Leadership.
  • Seeking opportunities to maximize profitability by assisting local and regional stakeholders in the development of solutions to emerging issues.

 

Contribute to and leads strategic projects on an as needed basis to improve the overall pricing and reimbursement knowledge and skills of Global Pricing colleagues and the broader organization.

jobs.description_text:
Job Description

Role Summary:


The Development and Commercialization Team (DCT) leader is accountable for delivering a fully integrated stage-appropriate CMC development and commercialization strategy which yields the target commercial product. The specific role will be responsible for advancing the company's biologics portfolio.


Correspondingly, the DCT leader will be responsible for delivering world class outcomes in the following areas:


  • Responsible for on-time, end-to end execution of DCT deliverables including – robust processes & analytics, an integrated control strategy, successful tech transfer packages, filing and approval, and a robust commercial supply chain to achieve uninterrupted long-term supply
  • Lead DCT.  Critically assesses all team deliverables & fosters a learning and collaborative environment.  Prioritizes, interrogates and mitigates risks across all factors that may impact technical, operational & regulatory success or timelines.  Analyzes and develops innovative solutions to unforeseen circumstances.
  • Responsible to ensure the best science and most robust processes are used, working closely with DCRC.  As the Product TPL takes ownership for the products’ technical processes and associated technical challenges, proactively prioritizing, interrogating and mitigating risks across technical, regulatory and operational factors.  Conducts options analysis and provides recommendation to governance for endorsement.
  • Represent CMC and effectively communicates across the governance bodies, stakeholders and teams.  Drives outcomes/decisions through influence, advocacy, & negotiation with stakeholders. Influences and challenges the product development team’s strategy to ensure a robust CMC strategy is achieved.  Identifies options to balance Speed/Cost/Robustness & achieve target commercial product.  Direct the necessary technical reviews, and ensure robust solutions and approaches are developed by working teams supporting the product.
  • Comply with our company's Global and regulatory requirements and execute current Good manufacturing Practices (cGMP) in the performance of day-to-day activities and all applicable job functions.
  • Work collaboratively to drive a safe and compliant culture.

Core Competencies:


  • Development and Commercialization Experience:  Demonstrated expertise of technical aspects and interdependencies across DS, DP, Device, Packaging, and Analytical, Regulatory, Quality, and Supply Chain from early development through to commercial manufacturing.  Deep understanding of connectivity between clinical, CMC, and HH to successfully launch a new product.
  • Technical Depth and Breadth of Experience:  Recognized as a credible technical leader through demonstrated scientific excellence in at least one CMC function and ability to navigate through uncertainty to favorable outcomes.
  • Strategic Thinking/Enterprise Mindset:  Understands and can articulate the “Big” picture, thinks strategically, and demonstrates a customer orientation.  Demonstrated ability to know how to ask the right questions to drive critical conversations to the best decision for the enterprise, considering options which balance speed, cost, and robustness.  Challenges team members to think beyond their area of expertise for the broader interests of the company and patients we serve.
  • Problem Solving and Innovative Thinking:  Gathers and analyzes data and effectively responds to new or complex situations, developing creative and innovative solutions to solve and mitigate complex problems.  Ability to leverage scientific expertise and growth mindset to interrogate data and foster debate within teams to enable innovative and robust problem solving. 
  • Ability to Navigate Ambiguity:  Able to operate and provide direction through ambiguity and adapt plans in the face of change, unexpected events, and/or new information.  Capable of both directive and consensus facilitation and awareness of when to apply each.  Leverages scientific data to make disciplined risk-based decisions and shown to be capable of discerning between risks worthy of escalation versus typical uncertainty associated with drug development, commercialization, and/or supply.
  • Productive Communication:  Plans and delivers ideas and information to others in an impactful manner with proven ability to lead complex discussions, influence stakeholders, and drive outcomes in the best interest of the enterprise.  Capable of tailoring communications to audiences, including governance bodies, senior leadership, team members, and individuals with backgrounds.  Practitioner of active listening who consistently strives to understands others’ perspectives, concerns, and ideas.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork:  Creates, leads, and sustains high performing teams, fostering an environment of open communication, enabling all team members to contribute their perspectives and collectively resolve issues.  Actively builds strong relationships with team members and key stakeholders to promote collaboration and seek robust perspectives.
  • Drives Results through Accountability:  Demonstrates effective leadership of team activities to ensure on-time, end-to-end project execution and delivery.  Drives accountability within teams to follow through on commitments, provides direct feedback when individuals are not meeting expectations, and closely partners with senior leaders to deliver on priorities.
  • Influence:  Ability to persuade and inspire others to take action, make decisions, or change their attitudes and behaviors.  Rapidly able to achieve trust with partners, enabling ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics to achieve their goals.
  • Ownership:  Exhibits a proactive mindset, a strong sense of initiative, and the willingness to take on challenges and see them through to completion.  Fostering a culture of accountability and resiliency within the team or organization and empowering others to take ownership of their roles and responsibilities.

Minimum Educational Requirement and Experience:


  • Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in relevant engineering or science fields with fifteen (15) years of relevant experience, or Master of Science (MS) Degree with twelve (12) years of relevant experience, or PhD with ten (10) years relevant experience

Required Experience and Skills:


  • Strong cross divisional networking skills and capabilities
  • Demonstrated functional and enterprise leadership, ability to influence at all levels of the organization.  
  • Strong collaborative skills and the ability to work strategically and in a detail-oriented framework with all levels of management.
  • Must have strong understanding of product management systems and tools, strong business and financial skills, ability to manage multiple programs and create a high-performance work environment

Preferred Experience and Skills:


  • Experience in Technical product stewardship
  • Demonstrated track record of successfully commercializing multiple large molecule programs across a variety of platforms
  • Expert knowledge in global regulatory requirements for large molecule commercialization and BLA assembly

jobs.title: Associate Director of Architecture
jobs.description_text:
Job Description

Bring your architectural expertise to high-impact global capital projects and help turn business needs into innovative, compliant facility solutions worldwide.

 

For our Global Engineering Solutions organization, we are currently recruiting an Associate Director of Architecture

 

Welcome to our team

With more than 300 employees, our Global Engineering Solutions (GES) organization is responsible for managing investment capital and designing and executing capital projects for our global organization worldwide. GES is organized as a Technology Center (responsible for the design and start-up of projects), a Project Delivery organization (responsible for project management) and a Business Service organization (responsible for project financial reporting). Within the Technology Center, our Global Design Engineering Solutions (DES) team, provides technical leadership and front-end design management to deliver fit-for-purpose, compliant, and cost-effective facility solutions for our company’s global capital programs.


Purpose of the role

Reporting into, and under the guidance of, the Technology Director of DES (based in the U.S.), this role leads the development of holistic global facility design solutions that support critical manufacturing and business objectives across multiple programs and business units. It partners with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into practical, compliant, and cost-effective architectural solutions.

The role also provides architectural subject matter expertise across the front-end planning lifecycle, from early concept development and site selection through FEL 3 Basis of Design. Your profile

jobs.title: Manager, Corporate Trade EMEA (f/m/d)
jobs.description_text:
Your Role

The Manager Corporate Trade EMEA will ensure Aptiv's Trade Compliance program across the EMEA region. Working closely with business units, manufacturing sites, supply chain, logistics, finance, tax, legal, engineering, and procurement teams, this role helps ensure compliance with customs, export controls, sanctions, and supply chain security requirements while supporting business growth and operational efficiency.


Roles and responsibilities

  • Ensure development and execution of Aptiv's Trade Compliance strategy, priorities, and initiatives across the EMEA region.
  • Monitor regulatory and trade policy developments and assess potential business impacts.
  • Support business growth initiatives, strategic projects, manufacturing transfers, and supply chain transformations from a Trade perspective.
  • Serve and lead as primary point of contact all customs audits, inquiries and regulatory reviews by customs authorities and other regulatory bodies in the EMEA region
  • Partner with business units to ensure Trade considerations are incorporated into decision-making.
  • Lead Trade Compliance Internal Assessments and drive remediation and closure of corrective actions.
  • Develop, maintain, and periodically update Trade policies, procedures, controls, and training materials.
  • Support implementation of Trade technology, automation, reporting, and data initiatives.
  • Conduct risk assessments, compliance reviews, and trend analysis to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver Trade Compliance training and awareness programs.
  • Identify, assess, escalate, and help resolve Trade Compliance risks and issues.
  • Drive corrective actions and monitor remediation activities from audits, assessments, and investigations.
  • Collaborate with business units, Supply Chain, Logistics, Procurement, Engineering, Finance, Tax, Legal, Manufacturing, and Commercial teams to ensure effective execution of Aptiv's global Trade framework.

 

Your background

  • Top-tier global trade experience, including with a law firm, consulting firm, and/or multinational company.
  • 5-10 years of relevant Trade experience with customs classification, export controls classification, origin determination, and Trade Compliance processes preferred.
  • Technology and/or automotive industry experience is desirable; experience with SAP GTS preferred.
  • Experience managing audits, assessments, corrective actions, regulatory compliance activities, and compliance risks in a complex global environment.
  • English fluency required; German preferred, additional language skills desirable.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with strong project management, organization, communication, and prioritization capabilities, including communication with senior leaders.
  • Experience using compliance, reporting, and business intelligence tools to support risk management and decision-making.

 

Why join Aptiv

You grow at Aptiv.

Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win.

You make an impact at Aptiv.

One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.

You have support at Aptiv.

We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.

 

Your benefits

As this role is advertised in few location benefits will be discussed with the recruiter during the first call.

Meet the Next-Generation Aptiv

At Aptiv, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most.

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on—advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies.

Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

 

Join Us to Deliver Innovative Solutions That People Trust!

The Global SOX and Audit Practice Manager is a key leadership role within the Internal Audit function, with global responsibility for the Sarbanes-Oxley program as well as the implementation of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence across the Internal Audit group. jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.description_text:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The role and Impact:

As a Supply Chain Technical Analyst, you will help improve the global Front End Logistics supply chain performance by turning complex operational and business needs into data-driven, financially sound, scalable solutions. You will apply supply chain expertise, advanced analytics, financial and business acumen, process design, automation, and AI to strengthen planning, cost efficiency, execution, and decision-making.


Business group
You will be joining Intel Foundry, a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing and innovation. Within Intel Foundry this role is in the Global Logistics organization in the group that supports the Font End factories Logistics.  The team is a global team that specializes in enabling efficient logistics and supply chain operations to support Intel's customers, partners, and business objectives. By driving operational excellence, the organization plays a key role in advancing Intel's leadership within the technology industry.
The role works closely with Front End Logistics leadership, Operations, Finance, Cost Leads, and cross-functional teams to align operational requirements with financial plans and business priorities, build reliable planning and reporting frameworks, simplify and automate processes, and deliver decision-ready insights to management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze complex global operational and financial data using advanced analytics, statistics, and optimization techniques to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and business drivers.
  • Turn ambiguous operational or business challenges into structured, repeatable processes with clear inputs, ownership, controls, outputs, and governance.
  • Support operational financial planning and forecasting, including plan-versus-actual and variance analysis, forecast assumptions, and cost visibility, in partnership with Finance and operational stakeholders.
  • Develop data structures, dashboards, standardized reports, and management views that provide a reconciled, decision-ready view of operational and financial performance.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for process simplification, automation, and AI to reduce manual work while maintaining appropriate business and financial controls.
  • Develop and maintain supply chain strategies that improve inventory, cost, capacity, and delivery performance.
  • Manage supply disruptions and communicate revised priorities, trade-offs, financial and operational impacts, and recommended solutions to stakeholders.
  • Lead or support cross-functional efficiency and continuous-improvement initiatives, using data to eliminate low-value or duplicate work, clarify ownership, and redirect resources to higher-value and growth activities.
  • Partner across Operations, Finance, and analytics teams to translate requirements and data between technical and business stakeholders.
  • Create process documentation, tools, and training that enable the organization to operate solutions and processes sustainably without relying on individual expertise.
  • Translate complex operational, analytical, and financial information into clear executive-level insights, risks, drivers, and recommendations.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business, Finance, Engineering, or Data Analytics.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in supply chain operations, planning, logistics, business analytics, financial planning, or operational business partnering.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience turning imperfect or fragmented business data into reconciled, decision-ready insights.
  • Proficiency in advanced Excel and data analysis/reporting tools, with experience using tools such as Power Query, Power BI/Tableau, SAP, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience using automation, AI, or advanced analytics to simplify business processes and improve decision-making.
  • Knowledge of supply chain metrics, forecasting methods, capacity planning, and inventory management.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including forecasting, actuals, variance analysis, cost drivers, and financial controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and improve business processes and identify automation opportunities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related field with 3+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience in semiconductor supply chains or high-tech manufacturing.
  • Experience partnering across Operations, Finance, supply chain, and analytics organizations.
  • Experience using automation, AI, or advanced analytics to simplify business processes and improve decision-making.
  • Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional improvement projects.
  • Strong executive communication, business partnering, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Quick learner and ability to self direct work



EU Pay Transparency

We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. This job is open for hiring in more then one country.

jobs.description_text:
Why this role is important to us

You will be joining the Business Development team in Charles River Development (CRD).  The mission of the team is to manage existing partners across the full spectrum of the CRD business, including but not limited to, Trading Partners such as Sell Sides, Trading Venues, and Data providers.  The team also coordinates across functions to drive the creation of new partnerships that add new capabilities to the CRD platform, address customer feedback, and ultimately drive revenue. 


Core Responsibilities

New Partnerships - Manage the Business Development Lifecycle

  • Work with prospective FIX Counterparts to expand liquidity options and price discovery for CRD Clients.
  • Interface with R&D, Product Strategy, and Sales to identify functional areas where new partnerships are needed.
  • Collaborate with Product Management to evaluate potential partners, including their functionality, integration capabilities, and pricing.
  • Drive the commercial negotiation that results in the basic terms of the partnership.
  • Work with Legal and Procurement teams to create a contract that will govern the partnership.
  • Following execution of the partnership, work with Sales Enablement and Marketing to establish a Go-To-Market plan.

Existing Partnerships

  • You will manage a set of partners.
    • Maintain strategic relationships with top producing brokers, including leveraging knowledge of their trading workflows and mutual customers.
    • Build relationships with the 500+ Sell Sides on the Charles River FIX Network globally.
    • Maintain monthly reporting, billing and risk inquiries, and more.
    • Manage contract renewals, amendments, and assignments as needed.
  • Manage the relationship with the partner, including solving problems in the partnership and working together to drive revenue for CRD and the partner.
  • Become knowledgeable of the partner offering and the commercial aspects of the partnership. 
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders about the partner and collaborate with partners when necessary.
  • Become familiar with the commercial arrangement of the partners that you manage.
  • Partner with other departments across the organization to support partner engagement, including but not limited to Product, Sales, Client Management, Legal, and Finance/Accounting.
  • Support product management in delivering their medium and long term road map.  Work with Product and Strategy to identify and execute on strategic partnerships to add value to the CRD ecosystem. New market assessment and sizing

Other Responsibilities

  • Assess vendor risk.
  • Ad hoc reporting
  • Strategic Projects
  • Drive strategic industry analysis and competitive intelligence.

  • Maintain prioritized requests from sales and clients.
  • Assist Sales/Client Management in client discussions around brokers/venues/workflows.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the FIX Network Ops team.


What we value

Required

  • Must have a strong understanding of Electronic Trading workflows from both a business and technical perspective across all asset classes. Including but not limited to Trader workflows, Connectivity details, FIX protocol.
  • Ability to prioritize
  • Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
  • Ability to ‘role up sleeves’, solve problems, and climb learning curve
  • Project management skills
  • Excellent follow-through, attention to detail and time management skills
  • Familiarity with the vendor ecosystem in buy side technology used by institutional asset managers, asset owners, hedge funds, etc.
  • Strong candidates will have worked in commercial software and taken part in both initial stages of business vetting and final role out of partnerships
  • Specific knowledge of the investment industry (financial instruments, workflows, major players, macro-economic influences, trends, etc.)
  • Strong interpersonal skills; demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with a wide range of individuals at all levels of the organization
  • Excellent executive communication (verbal and written) skills
  • Active contributor with high motivation, the ability to take initiative, set priorities, and perform tasks with minimal supervision

Preferred

  • Global business development experience preferred, including experience formulating partnerships, reviewing contracts related to partnerships, etc.
  • 3 - 5 years of relevant experience
