Shape international communications around major medical congresses, data readouts and scientific milestones, translating complex information into compelling narratives for healthcare, trade, business and consumer audiences in international markets.  Drive unbranded disease awareness efforts that build understanding of Inflammation conditions among patients, caregivers and healthcare providers, helping prepare international audiences for Takeda’s next wave of innovation.  Lead proactive and reactive media relations for the Inflammation therapeutic area, building relationships with key international media and preparing leaders and spokespeople for external engagements.  Lead issues and crisis preparedness for the Inflammation therapeutic area across Core Markets and Clusters, including scenario planning, holding statements and rapid-response plans in partnership with Medical Affairs, Legal and Regulatory.  Partner with IBU communicators to set measurement approaches that track reach, sentiment and impact, using insights to refine programs, sharpen narratives and scale what works over time, including LLM influence. Strategic business partner with the ability to translate business objectives into impactful product communications strategies.  Ability to work directly with senior executives and a proven track record negotiating and forming consensus among various parties.  Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.  Strong organizational skills accompanied by the ability to multi-task and problem-solve.  Experience in adopting and driving AI-powered solutions.  Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.  Team player and self-starter with a positive attitude. Given the nature of this assignment, we are looking for someone who can quickly understand our existing compensation structures, processes and priorities, operate with a high degree of autonomy, and make an immediate contribution. What You'll Do Compensation Planning & Programmes Take ownership of key activities within the annual compensation review cycle, including planning, preparation, execution, validation and audit of merit increases, promotions and other compensation changes. Act as a subject matter expert, providing guidance and recommendations to Total Rewards, HX Business Partners, Finance, Payroll and business leaders throughout the annual compensation process. Independently manage complex compensation analyses and provide recommendations relating to promotions, internal mobility, retention and other compensation decisions. Proactively identify risks, inconsistencies and opportunities to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of compensation processes. Market Pricing, Job Architecture & Salary Structures Independently lead market pricing and benchmarking activities using external compensation survey data, including Aon Radford, alongside internal compensation information. Apply expert judgement when evaluating market data, particularly where benchmark information is limited, inconsistent or does not directly align with internal roles. Lead complex job evaluations, providing well-supported recommendations on job levels, market matches and salary ranges. Provide expert guidance on the application and maintenance of job architecture, job levels and compensation structures. Support the review and development of salary ranges, ensuring appropriate consideration of market competitiveness, geographic differences and internal equity. Advise on appropriate salary ranges for external recruitment, balancing market conditions, organisational consistency and existing employee compensation. Pay Equity, Transparency & Reporting Lead or independently deliver compensation-related pay equity analyses, identifying potential disparities, assessing underlying drivers and developing recommendations for consideration by Total Rewards leadership. Take ownership of key elements of Ireland Gender Pay Gap reporting, including data validation, analysis, reporting and stakeholder coordination. Identify compensation data, process or structural gaps that may present challenges for pay equity or transparency initiatives and recommend practical solutions. jobs.description_text: Be wary of scams, Workhuman will never ask for payments or seek personal information beyond that which is necessary to process your application for employment. If in doubt, do not share your personal or financial information and feel free to reach out to Workhuman directly at globalrecruitment@workhuman.com. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Compensation Analyst to join our Total Rewards team on a 9-month fixed-term contract to provide maternity leave coverage. This role will support the delivery of Workhuman’s compensation programs across our global organization, with particular focus on annual compensation planning, market benchmarking, job evaluation, salary range management, pay equity, and Ireland compensation requirements. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, analyzing complex compensation data, partnering with Human Experience Business Partners and business leaders, and translating market and internal data into clear compensation recommendations. What You’ll Do Compensation Planning & Programs Support the planning, preparation, execution, and audit of the annual compensation review cycle, including merit increases, promotions, and other compensation changes. Partner with Total Rewards, HX Business Partners, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders throughout the annual compensation process. Perform compensation analysis and prepare recommendations to support compensation decisions, including promotions, internal moves, retention reviews, and other ad hoc requests. Review compensation proposals for alignment with established salary ranges, internal equity, market competitiveness, and compensation guidelines. Market Pricing & Salary Ranges Participate in the annual review and update of compensation salary ranges, incorporating external market data, internal compensation practices, and organizational needs. Conduct market pricing using compensation survey data, including Aon Radford, to assess the competitiveness of Workhuman roles and compensation structures. Complete job evaluations and market analyses for new and changing roles, including recommendations regarding job level, market match, and salary range. Use Aon JobLink and other job evaluation tools to support consistent job leveling and job architecture. Review and recommend appropriate salary ranges for external job postings, considering market data, internal equity, location, level, and existing employee compensation. Pay Equity & Reporting Support compensation-related pay equity analysis and the development of appropriate recommendations in partnership with Total Rewards leadership. Lead or support preparation of the Ireland Gender Pay Gap Report, including data validation, analysis, reporting, and coordination with key stakeholders. Support broader pay transparency and compensation reporting initiatives as required. Partner with HRIS and other teams to maintain accurate compensation, job, and organizational data used for reporting and analysis. Compensation Consulting & Governance Provide day-to-day compensation guidance to HX Business Partners and other stakeholders on salary ranges, promotions, offers, internal moves, and other compensation matters. Conduct internal equity reviews to help ensure compensation decisions are consistent and equitable across comparable employees and roles. Support the ongoing maintenance of Workhuman’s job architecture, including job profiles, levels, market matches, and compensation ranges. Identify compensation trends, risks, or inconsistencies and provide data-driven recommendations to Total Rewards leadership. Develop clear compensation analyses, reports, and presentations for business and HX leadership. Support documentation and continuous improvement of compensation processes, guidelines, and standard operating procedures. Participate in compensation projects and other Total Rewards initiatives as business needs arise. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in compensation, ideally within a global organization. Strong knowledge of compensation principles, including market pricing, salary structures, job evaluation, internal equity, and compensation planning. Experience supporting or managing annual merit and compensation review processes. Demonstrated ability to analyze compensation data and translate findings into practical recommendations. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with advanced proficiency in Excel or similar analytical tools. Experience working with HR systems and large employee datasets. Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain compensation concepts clearly to both HR and business audiences. Experience working across multiple countries or geographic markets is beneficial. Experience That Would Be a Plus: Workday, including compensation and Advanced Compensation Aon Radford compensation market data Aon JobLink Syndio or other pay equity analysis tools Ireland Gender Pay Gap reporting Job architecture and job leveling Pay transparency requirements and practices Compensation support across Ireland, the UK, and/or the United States What Success Looks Like During the 9-month assignment, this person will help ensure that Workhuman’s core compensation programs continue to operate smoothly and accurately, including successful delivery of the 2027 annual compensation cycle, updated salary ranges, timely Ireland Gender Pay Gap reporting, and consistent market pricing and compensation guidance throughout the year. At Workhuman®, our mission is to bring more humanity to the workplace. We recognize and embrace individual differences and believe that diversity, inclusion, and belonging are essential to our long-term growth and success. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply—even if you don’t feel you meet every qualification listed above. We’re looking for collaborative, innovative humans with a growth mindset who can bring unique perspectives to our team. We are also committed to creating an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates . If you require any accommodations or support during the application or interview process, or encounter any accessibility barriers, please contact us at globalrecruitment@workhuman.com . We are dedicated to ensuring equal access to opportunities for all individuals. Workhuman is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees. We proudly provide a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.description_text: Job Application for Head of Partnerships at LearnUpon Back to jobs Head of Partnerships Dublin, Ireland Apply Work Mode: Hybrid 3+ days per week in our Dublin office Department: Partnerships About the Company LearnUpon partners with over 1,600 organisations globally to unlock the potential of employees, customers & members through learning that’s easy, scalable and focused on results. Read more about life at LearnUpon here . About the Team As we look to accelerate new customer acquisition and revenue growth for FY27, our Revenue organization is integrating our indirect channels, partners, and co-selling motions. The Partnerships function is transitioning from a standalone team into a highly accountable, pipeline-generating, and conversion-acceleration engine. We partner closely with sales and GTM leadership to break down functional silos, align reporting, process, and funnel management, and directly power LearnUpon’s most ambitious commercial objectives. About the Opportunity As we look to accelerate new customer acquisition and revenue growth along with improved expansion and retention, we have a key opportunity to integrate our indirect channels, partners, and co-selling motions within the Revenue organization. This role will partner with sales and GTM leadership to better align with our revenue goals, breaking down silos to jointly align reporting, process, and funnel management. We are seeking a Head of Partnerships to transition this function from a standalone team into a highly accountable, pipeline-generating, and conversion-acceleration engine. Reporting directly to the VP of Revenue, you will be the single-threaded owner of the entire funnel for partner-generated and partner-influenced revenue. Skills & Experience Must-Haves 5+ years of global leadership of a Partnership motion, alongside a proven track record in a senior GTM or Revenue leadership role, ideally within a fast-growth company scaling toward or beyond $200M ARR. Deep experience in the typical SaaS ecosystem for L&D and HR including content creation, training and certification, onboarding, and customer education platforms. Demonstrated ability to move a motion and teams from a foundational stage, scaling with systems and process that drive growth exponentially. Work from our Dublin, Ireland office to provide hands-on guidance to the local team. Comfortable being held to the same rigorous forecasting and pipeline standards as direct sales leaders. Travel requirement to the US is quarterly or more frequently based on key relationships. A self-starter who can drive behavior changes across departments and lead with curiosity. and lead with curiosity. Nice-to-Haves Deep understanding of channel infrastructure, partner marketing frameworks, and cross-functional revenue operations tracking. *If you don’t tick every box but believe this role is a mutually good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you. Why choose LearnUpon? From comprehensive rewards and generous time off to meaningful investment in your growth and development, LearnUpon gives you the support, trust, and opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career. Learn more here . Hiring Process Qualified applicants may be invited to an initial screening call with a member of our TA Team. Successful candidates will be invited to a series of practical interviews. Finally, candidates will have an interview with our CFO. Successful candidates will be contacted with an offer to join our team. Note: At LearnUpon, we utilise AI to enhance the speed and quality of our screening and assessment practices, but our hiring decisions are always human. LearnUpon is an Equal Opportunities Employer We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, family status, age, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, membership of the Traveller community, or any other legally protected status. Check out our Careers site and Instagram to learn more about working at LearnUpon. By submitting your application, you agree to LearnUpon's Privacy Policy . Create a Job Alert Interested in building your career at LearnUpon? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Site Reliability
jobs.description_text: Job Application for Staff Engineer, Site Reliability at LearnUpon Back to jobs Staff Engineer, Site Reliability Dublin Apply Work Mode: Flex 1+ days per week in our Dublin office Department: Engineering About the Company LearnUpon partners with over 1,600 organisations globally to unlock the potential of employees, customers & members through learning that’s easy, scalable and focused on results. Read more about life at LearnUpon here . About the Team Our Engineering organization is dedicated to building robust, scalable infrastructure that handles world-scale platform demands . As part of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, we focus on system architecture, absolute performance, and technical innovation . Operating with high ownership and technical expertise, we are responsible for the scale-out of the LearnUpon infrastructure, championing internal self-service tooling, and embedding a culture of observability and shared operational responsibility across all engineering squads . About the Opportunity As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will be a principal technical leader and a key catalyst for our infrastructure's evolution. In this role, you will take ownership of our core platform resilience, driving the strategy to build out an advanced, cost-effective observability function spanning metrics, logs, and transaction tracking. This opportunity requires a strategic thinker who can design cross-team SLO/SLI frameworks, navigate complex distributed system requirements, and mentor talent to ensure LearnUpon scales efficiently to support our ambitious global goals. In addition, you’ll be responsible for: Infrastructure Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve and scale our infrastructure for performance, observability, maintainability, and cost, by creating innovative solutions. Observability Function Strategy: Lead our efforts to build an observability function that incorporates application metrics, application transaction tracking, and event log management. Resilience & Scaling: Drive the processes to maintain resilient, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure while working with other Engineering teams to provide solutions that meet their ongoing requirements. Tooling & Self-Service: Build tools focused on measuring, monitoring, and alerting, with an eye towards self-service in order to promote Engineers’ ownership of observability. Operational Agility & Support: React quickly to changing customer and business needs and actively participate in the team's on-call rota. Team Up-Leveling: Mentor junior talent and effectively communicate complex technical ideas to both technical and non-technical peers. Skills & Experience Must-Haves 7+ years of experience in a software or Ops role. 5+ years of cloud engineering experience, with at least 2 years of experience with AWS. Experience deploying Microservice environments using containerisation technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker. Experience designing and implementing Observability tech stacks, championing its benefits to Engineering teams, and managing the associated cost analysis of metrics gathering, effort, and tooling. Ability to architect the design of SLO/SLI implementations that balance the needs of different teams. Experience building and supporting large-scale distributed systems that back a consumer app or website with associated requirements of performance, security, and disaster recovery. Experience with implementing IaC (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform, etc.), automation tooling (e.g., Puppet, Ansible etc.), and CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins, Travis CI, GitLab, etc.). Experience using AI tools to streamline tasks and improve efficiencies. Nice-to-Haves Experience with database scaling would be a strong plus. Certification in AWS, any PaaS, and/or related technologies. *If you don’t tick every box but believe this role is a mutually good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you. Why choose LearnUpon? From comprehensive rewards and generous time off to meaningful investment in your growth and development, LearnUpon gives you the support, trust, and opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career. Learn more here . Hiring Process Qualified applicants may be invited to an initial screening call with a member of our TA Team. Successful candidates will be invited to a series of practical interviews. Finally, candidates will have an interview with our CTO. Successful candidates will be contacted with an offer to join our team. Note: At LearnUpon, we utilise AI to enhance the speed and quality of our screening and assessment practices, but our hiring decisions are always human. LearnUpon is an Equal Opportunities Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, family status, age, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, membership of the Traveller community, or any other legally protected status. Check out our Careers site and Instagram to learn more about working at LearnUpon. By submitting your application, you agree to LearnUpon's Privacy Policy . Create a Job Alert Interested in building your career at LearnUpon? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email. The team is widely recognised in the market for structuring and executing innovative deals across acquisition/leveraged finance, investment‑grade and syndicated lending, real estate finance, fund finance, and refinancing.      About the Role       As a Debt Finance Associate, you will play a central role in the execution of loan and security transactions, working closely with partners and senior associates to deliver pragmatic, timely, and high‑quality advice. You will manage discrete workstreams end‑to‑end (drafting, negotiation, due diligence, CP/closing, and post‑completion), contribute to client relationship development, and support knowledge initiatives that enhance consistency and efficiency across the practice.    This role offers significant scope for growth and evolution, and a successful candidate will have the opportunity to broaden their exposure across product types and sectors, taking on increasing responsibility as they develop.      You will       • Advise on Irish law aspects of acquisition and leveraged finance, unitranche/term loan B, revolving credit facilities, investment‑grade and syndicated lending, ABL, and real estate development/investment finance and fund finance.  • Draft, negotiate, and manage LMA‑based facility agreements, security documents (debentures, share charges, mortgages), accession agreements, intercreditor arrangements, and related finance deliverables.  • Lead due diligence on borrower groups and collateral packages, identify key issues, propose solutions, and present findings succinctly to clients and deal teams.  • Own CP and closing workstreams: build and run CP lists, coordinate signings and funds flows, and manage post‑completion deliverables including CRO filings and Land Registry/Registry of Deeds applications.  • Liaise proactively with counterpart counsel, lenders/agents, financial advisers, and internal specialists (Tax, Corporate/M&A, Real Estate, Restructuring).  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership, and support trainees/trainee solicitors through coaching and supervision.  • Use legal technology and GenAI tools responsibly (e.g., document automation, drafting aids), following firm policy and practice group playbooks.

jobs.title: Innovation Analyst
jobs.description_text: Arthur Cox LLP is one of Ireland’s leading law firms. We are an “all-island” firm with offices in Dublin and Belfast. We also have offices in London, New York, and San Francisco. Our practice encompasses all aspects of corporate and business law.  With 600 legal staff and a total headcount of nearly 900, we provide a comprehensive service to an international client base ranging from multinational organisations, banks, and financial institutions and established global leaders to government agencies and new players in emerging industry sectors.  Our story has been defined by our progressive outlook. For over 100 years, we have led the way in the legal field in Ireland. For our clients, we work to deliver the best service and support. With an independent, entrepreneurial spirit of innovation leading the way.      Department:  IT  Location:  Dublin (hybrid)  Reports to:  Innovation Manager  Contract Type:  Permanent, Full-time      Background:      The legal sector has entered a period of significant change driven by artificial intelligence, automation, data, new client expectations and evolving models of legal service delivery. Arthur Cox has a strong history of innovation and is committed to ensuring that technology is adopted in a practical, responsible and commercially valuable way across the firm.     The Innovation & AI team plays a central role in this agenda. Part of the firm’s Legal Tech & Innovation Services Group, the team helps the firm identify, assess, implement and scale the technologies and working practices that will support the future delivery of legal services. It owns the AI and legal technology product portfolio across its full lifecycle - from horizon scanning and opportunity assessment, through pilots, business cases, implementation and adoption, to ongoing optimisation and retirement - and leads the AI Enablement pillar of the firm’s AI strategy, including the adoption and effective use of tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Legora and AI agents. The team works closely with lawyers, Innovation Lawyers, Knowledge, Risk & Compliance, IT and firm leadership to ensure that AI and legal technology are deployed in a way that improves client service, enhances lawyer effectiveness, manages risk and supports the firm’s strategic priorities.          About the role:   We are seeking a talented individual interested in building a career focused on the application of technology - and, increasingly, AI - within a dynamic client service business. This role is an exceptional opportunity for someone eager to learn how to combine business process design, change management and technology to foster innovation and transform the delivery of legal services.     Reporting to an Innovation Manager, you will become proficient in a wide variety of legal technology tools and solutions, develop skills in project and change management, assist with vendor and product assessments, and support the implementation of technology solutions in a business setting. There will be a significant emphasis on Generative AI and the firm’s AI Enablement agenda, giving you foundational knowledge of how AI works and practical experience applying it in daily business tasks — including through the firm’s AI platform, Legora, and Microsoft Copilot.     This opportunity is ideal for an aspiring individual to thrive in a fast-paced and demanding professional services environment where process redesign and AI are poised to drive substantial disruption over the next decade.

Head of Risk Framework


Corporate Title: Director

Location: London, Dublin, Jersey, Malta, Spain, Portugal, Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Cape Town

Reporting to: Chief Risk Officer


About the Role


The Head of Risk Framework is responsible for designing, strengthening, maintaining and overseeing the Group's risk management framework, including the Risk Management Policy and the supporting tools, techniques and documents required for a proportionate, scalable and effective approach to risk management. The role ensures the framework remains aligned to Apex's strategy, risk appetite and regulatory obligations, and supports consistent risk identification, assessment, monitoring, escalation and reporting across the Group.

The role provides senior leadership across risk framework development, risk taxonomy, classification, risk appetite, risk assessment, incident management, key risk indicators, policy governance, product risk assessment and the Group Risk and Control Profile. It works closely with executive management, regional and functional Risk teams, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit and first-line risk owners to embed the Three Lines of Defence model and strengthen risk capability and culture.


Accountabilities & Key Responsibilities


  • Design, strengthen, maintain and oversee the Group Risk Management Framework, including the Risk Management Policy and supporting standards, tools, techniques and guidance.
  • Maintain the Group risk taxonomy, impact and likelihood classification matrix, risk appetite methodology, risk assessment approach, interconnected risk mapping and key risk indicator standards.
  • Facilitate the Group-level business risk assessment and oversee day-to-day maintenance of the Group Risk and Control Profile, including monitoring and escalation of material trigger events or issues.
  • Provide support, challenge and oversight for local and functional business risk assessments to promote consistent application of Group standards.
  • Support the Chief Risk Officer in escalating and communicating priority risk matters to executive management, the Group Audit & Risk Committee and the Group Board.
  • Design, maintain and oversee the Group Business Continuity Management and crisis management frameworks.
  • Own the Group Policy Framework and work with policy owners to ensure minimum standards, governance, review discipline and lifecycle requirements are met.
  • Provide senior sponsorship and oversight for risk technology and data initiatives, including integration of the Risk Management Framework into Riskonnect and related workflows.
  • Ensure risk systems and reporting capabilities support links between risks, controls, incidents, findings, actions and changes in risk profile over time.
  • Lead, develop and allocate priorities across the Risk Framework team, supporting succession, capability development and effective delivery.
  • Promote a strong risk culture and support Learning and Development in maintaining effective risk training and awareness materials.
  • Lead the development and implementation of scenario/stress testing exercises and reports.
  • Lead major incident response.  Maintain and develop incident management response protocols
  • Support the Chief Risk Officer including risk reporting at board level

Skills & Experience


  • Significant senior-level experience in enterprise risk management within a regulated financial services environment.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise risk frameworks, risk appetite, risk assessment, controls, incident management, business continuity and policy governance.
  • Experience operating in a global, multi-jurisdictional and complex organisation.
  • Demonstrable experience designing, implementing and embedding risk management frameworks and methodologies.
  • Experience leading risk transformation, GRC platform implementation or material risk technology change.
  • Strong judgement and the ability to provide independent oversight, constructive challenge and clear escalation as part of the Second Line of Defence.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills, including experience with executive and Board-level governance forums.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, with the ability to translate complex risk matters into practical actions and decision-useful information.
  • Proven leadership and people-management capability, including developing technical specialists and delivering through cross-functional teams.
  • Professional risk qualification, such as IRM, FRM, PRM or equivalent, is advantageous.
  • Experience in fund administration, fiduciary, corporate services, asset servicing or a comparable regulated financial services environment is advantageous.

Why Join Us


  • Lead the continued development of the Group's enterprise-wide approach to risk management.
  • Work closely with the Chief Risk Officer, senior executives and governance committees on the Group's most material risk priorities.
  • Shape the use of risk technology, data and reporting across a growing international business.
  • Lead a specialist team and influence how risk management supports strategy, growth and better decision-making across Apex.

Lead Engineer, Evidence Management Digital Ecosystem

Scientific Affairs and Regulatory Affairs | Appian-first engineering and application architecture leadership

Lead Engineer, Evidence Management Digital Ecosystem

Scientific Affairs and Regulatory Affairs | Appian-first engineering and application architecture leadership

About Johnson & Johnson, MedTech

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we are developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments. Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

This is primarily a hybrid role for candidates currently based within commuting distance of a Johnson & Johnson office in the United States (preferably New Jersey).  Remote candidates may also be considered on a limited basis if they hold strong credentials and required experience.

Position Summary

The Lead Engineer, Evidence Management is responsible for engineering leadership, application architecture, and delivery governance for the Evidence Management digital ecosystem spanning Scientific Affairs and Regulatory Affairs.

This is primarily an Appian-first, AI-enabled, and ecosystem-oriented engineering role. The successful candidate must bring strong hands-on and strategic experience with Appian platform architecture, Appian solution design, Appian integrations, application architecture, engineering quality practices, and SAFe delivery. Most work expectations remain primarily focused on the Regulatory Affairs domain, with Scientific Affairs included as an adjacent and expanding evidence management stakeholder group.

Mandatory Capability Requirement: Candidates will be evaluated for demonstrated ability to engineer, architect, and deliver secure, compliant, scalable solutions that create measurable business value for Regulatory Affairs and support evidence management needs across Scientific Affairs. Appian technology skills are mandatory for this position.

Role Purpose

  • Serve as the Lead Engineer for evidence management capabilities covering regulatory and scientifc workflow, case management, process automation, content/data flows, integrations, and user experience.
  • Define and guide application architecture for platforms supporting regulatory planning, submissions, evidence intake, evidence assessment, regulatory intelligence, workflow automation, post-approval activities, scientific evidence collaboration, and analytics.
  • Maintain primary focus on Regulatory Affairs delivery priorities while designing solutions that can also support Scientific Affairs processes, evidence workflows, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Lead AI-enabled modernization by identifying high-value evidence management use cases, designing scalable implementation patterns, and ensuring responsible adoption in regulated environments.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Scientific Affairs, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Data Governance, and IT delivery teams to translate complex business needs into compliant, maintainable technology solutions.
  • Act as the lead technical advisor for Appian application decisions, integrations, data products, engineering practices, and AI-enabled capabilities across the evidence management ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

1. Evidence Management Application Engineering and Architecture

·       Own and maintain the application architecture strategy and engineering roadmap for evidence management capabilities across Regulatory Affairs and Scientific Affairs.

·       Design scalable, interoperable, and compliant solutions across regulatory platforms, Appian applications, data flows, workflows, integrations, content repositories, and analytics capabilities.

·       Translate complex regulatory and scientific evidence processes into practical application designs, engineering patterns, data models, and delivery backlogs.

·       Drive design governance for new capabilities, major enhancements, technical debt remediation, platform modernization, and cross-system interoperability.

·       Ensure solution designs align with enterprise standards for cloud, cybersecurity, privacy, lifecycle management, supportability, and technical sustainability.

·       Lead engineering and application architecture for Appian-based regulatory workflow, evidence case management, process automation, integration, records, reporting, and user experience capabilities and define Appian design standards

2. Evidence Management Leadership

·       Maintain deep understanding of Regulatory Affairs operating processes and technology needs across planning, submissions, regulatory intelligence, workflow orchestration, post-approval activities, content management, compliance, and analytics.

·       Ensure evidence management capabilities support traceability, auditability, role-based access, status visibility, decision history, and inspection-ready records where required.

·       Extend the evidence management architecture and engineering patterns to support Scientific Affairs use cases such as evidence intake, evidence evaluation, collaboration workflows, knowledge search, scientific content traceability, and analytics.

·       Identify common process, data, content, workflow, and integration patterns that can be reused across Scientific Affairs and Regulatory Affairs while respecting domain-specific controls.

3. Data Management and AI-enabled Evidence Management

·       Define the AI-enabled engineering roadmap for evidence management, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, NLP, semantic search, knowledge graphs, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation where appropriate.

·       Guide proof-of-concepts, pilots, and scaled implementations for AI capabilities with clear business value, security, usability, and compliance controls.

·       Establish patterns for monitoring, hallucination risk mitigation, source traceability, human-in-the-loop review, prompt/version governance, and model performance evaluation.

·       Define data architecture principles for evidence metadata, Appian data models, regulatory master data, scientific evidence content, operational data, unstructured content, and analytics-ready data products.

·       Establish engineering standards for APIs, event-driven integration, workflow orchestration, data lineage, data quality, access control, and platform interoperability.

4. Compliance, Risk and Responsible AI Governance

·       Ensure engineering and architecture decisions support GxP, SOX, privacy, cybersecurity, auditability, data integrity, validation or qualification expectations, and regulated SDLC or computerized system assurance practices.

·       Partner with Quality, Security, Privacy, Regulatory Affairs, Scientific Affairs, and Data Governance stakeholders to assess technology, Appian-specific, evidence-management-specific, and AI-specific risks.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, application architecture, solution architecture, platform architecture, low-code platform architecture, data architecture, or enterprise technology delivery.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience engineering, architecting, and delivering solutions on the Appian platform.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Appian solution design, including process modeling, interfaces, records, integrations, data models, rules, reports, role-based security, application lifecycle governance, and environment management.
  • Strong experience leading application engineering delivery in Agile or SAFe environments, including backlog shaping, technical design, code quality, release readiness, dependency management, and production support considerations.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting or engineering AI-enabled enterprise solutions, including Generative AI and/or Machine Learning use cases.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Large Language Models, prompt engineering, semantic search, vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, model orchestration, AI observability, and responsible AI controls.
  • Experience designing secure, cloud-native, API-enabled, workflow-enabled, and data-centric platforms in complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting regulated business functions such as Regulatory Affairs, Scientific Affairs, Quality, Clinical, Safety, R&D, or Life Sciences technology.
  • Working knowledge of GxP, SOX, privacy, cybersecurity, data integrity, regulated SDLC, validation, qualification, or computerized system assurance practices.
  • Strong ability to translate business operating models, regulatory processes, and evidence management needs into scalable technical architectures and delivery-ready engineering designs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Appian certification or equivalent demonstrated enterprise Appian engineering and architecture experience.
  • Experience with Regulatory Affairs platforms, RIM solutions, submission management, regulatory intelligence, regulatory analytics, content management, knowledge management systems, or evidence management platforms.
  • Experience supporting Scientific Affairs, Medical Affairs, evidence generation, scientific content workflows, or knowledge search capabilities.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Copilot extensibility, AI Foundry, agent frameworks, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience applying AI in regulated environments, including human-in-the-loop workflows, validation strategy, model monitoring, data governance, and risk-based controls.
  • Architecture, engineering, or Agile certifications such as TOGAF, Azure Solutions Architect, Appian certification, SAFe Architect, SAFe Agilist, or equivalent.
  • Experience leading vendor technology assessments, Appian solution reviews, AI platform evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and enterprise-scale implementation planning.

The Digital Mfg Systems Analyst, SC Technology plays a key role in advancing digital capabilities across DePuy Synthes Supply Chain by connecting business needs with scalable technology solutions. This role partners with Supply Chain stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and technology partners to translate business priorities into product requirements and deliver low-code and automation capabilities that improve productivity, user experience, and operational effectiveness.

The successful candidate will support the vision and priorities for Supply Chain technology products, help translate product roadmap features into well-defined requirements, and collaborate across functions to deliver solutions using low-code and related digital technologies. Job Description:

 

DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Sr. Manager, EMEA - SC Technology Logistics

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopedics business to establish a standalone orthopedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.


Job Overview

The Senior Manager, EMEA Supply Chain Technology - Logistics is the accountable technology leader for the DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver domain. The role owns the regional Deliver technology roadmap and ensures that logistics technology capabilities are reliable, secure, compliant, scalable and aligned with DePuy Synthes business priorities, EMEA operational needs and global Supply Chain Technology strategies.

The role partners with regional and global Supply Chain, Deliver, Technology, Digital, Architecture, Finance, Quality, Procurement and external logistics providers to translate business strategy into an integrated portfolio of technology investments, operational improvements and transformation outcomes. The Senior Manager balances transformation delivery with uninterrupted business operations and clear accountability for value realisation.

 

Leadership Profile

A seasoned, strategic and pragmatic technology leader who combines business partnership with technical judgement, operational discipline and delivery accountability. The successful candidate is comfortable making trade-offs, creating clarity across organisational boundaries, developing talent and ensuring that transformation produces sustainable, measurable value without compromising service, compliance or continuity.

 

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Roadmap Ownership

·        Own and maintain the multi-year DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver technology roadmap, aligned to the business strategy, network evolution, operational priorities and global technology direction.

·        Translate business capabilities and pain points into a prioritised, sequenced and funded portfolio with clear dependencies, decision points, risks and measurable outcomes.

·        Provide strategic direction across core logistics platforms, warehouse automation, data, integration and emerging digital capabilities.


Regional, Business Unit and Global Accountability

·        Serve as the primary technology partner for DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver, with clear accountability for regional outcomes while operating within global product, platform, architecture, cybersecurity and compliance governance.

·        Clarify decision rights, ownership and handoffs across the regional business, DePuy Synthes, global Deliver, ERP and platform teams, and shared technology functions.

·        Represent EMEA priorities in global forums and ensure that global standards and roadmaps are adopted appropriately, with regional requirements and trade-offs made transparent.


Technology Ecosystem and Architecture

·        Provide end-to-end oversight of the EMEA Deliver technology ecosystem, including ERP, WMS, WCS/WES, TMS, warehouse automation, transportation, labelling, visibility, data and analytics, and internal and external integrations.

·        Partner with enterprise and solution architects to define target-state architecture, reduce fragmentation and technical debt, and ensure secure, scalable and supportable integration patterns.

·        Ensure roadmap alignment across transactional platforms, warehouse execution and control layers, automation equipment, data platforms, partner connectivity and related ecosystem services.


Operational Reliability and Lifecycle Ownership

·        Own technology service health and lifecycle performance across the regional Deliver landscape, including availability, resilience, supportability, capacity, obsolescence, cybersecurity, compliance and disaster-recovery readiness.

·        Establish proactive operational governance, service-level expectations, risk management, root-cause follow-through and lifecycle plans with product teams, service partners and site stakeholders.

·        Ensure critical incidents and recurring service issues are addressed with sustainable corrective actions, transparent communication and appropriate escalation.


Portfolio, Financial and Benefits Accountability

·        Own portfolio planning and prioritisation across run, lifecycle, compliance, growth and transformation demand, ensuring investment is aligned to strategic and operational value.

·        Develop and maintain business cases, funding plans and financial forecasts across CAPEX, OPEX and run costs, with disciplined tracking of commitments, risks and variances.

·        Define benefits, baselines and success measures at initiative level, and drive value-realisation reviews with business and Finance partners.


3PL and External Partner Technology Governance

Job Description:

About the Role

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is recruiting a Postdoctoral Researcher, AI Safety to join our Data, Data Science & AI organization. This is a fixed-term research appointment of two years reporting directly to the Scientific Fellow, AI Safety.


The role can be based at one of our sites in Belgium, The Netherlands, UK or Ireland


Agentic AI is becoming central to pharmaceutical R&D—from discovery and translational science to development and regulatory work—where evidence standards are rigorous and errors can ultimately affect patient safety and outcomes. Our GenAI Platform supports that shift across a rapidly expanding population of autonomous workflows. Safety at this scale cannot be retrofitted through checks written into individual applications; it must be a property of how these systems are built.

As a Postdoctoral Fellow, you will lead a focused, publishable research program on how agentic AI in pharmaceutical R&D can be governed through provable controls, continuously tested through adversarial assurance, and made safe by construction. Your research agenda will sit within one or more of the team's three connected mandates:

  • Provable controls. Develop deterministic, explainable controls that persist throughout agentic workflows, and methods to verify that they hold.
  • Adversarial assurance. Advance continuous red-teaming and evaluation methods that test safeguards against credible failure scenarios and produce defensible evidence.
  • Safety-native architecture. Investigate pre- and post-training safety alignment and defense-in-depth techniques that make agentic AI safe by construction for regulated pharmaceutical R&D.

This is a hands-on research role with real systems as the testbed. You will formulate research questions, build the prototypes and experiments that answer them, publish the results, and work with our engineering partners to carry validated methods into the platform.


Key Responsibilities

Research Program

  • Execute an independent research agenda (agreed with the Scientific Fellow/mentor) on controls, adversarial assurance, or safety-native architecture for agentic AI in regulated scientific settings.
  • Design rigorous, reproducible experiments—including baselines, ablations, and uncertainty estimates—that test whether a safety property genuinely holds.
  • Evaluate pre-training data interventions and post-training methods—including supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and safety tuning—for regulated scientific use cases, including whether safety properties persist under domain adaptation.
  • Prototype layered architectures that constrain agent behavior, and translate scientific, quality, privacy, and regulatory requirements into testable system specifications.
  • Work with platform engineering to move validated methods from prototype into the GenAI Platform, with documentation that makes results reproducible and auditable.
  • Present your work to scientific, engineering, and leadership audiences, and represent the team at conferences, workshops, and standards activities.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not frontier model development. We are not pre-training foundation models at scale. The research question is how alignment and architecture should be adapted so that the models and platforms available to us are safe for pharmaceutical R&D.
  • Not a guardrail-prompt role. Safety here is architectural and enforcement is deterministic. A system prompt asking a model to behave is not a control.
  • Not research in isolation. Your research questions come from real agentic workflows, and success includes evidence that the methods work on them—not only a publication.
  • Not a production engineering or operations role. You prototype and validate; platform teams own production deployment, on-call support, and long-term maintenance.

Key Qualifications

PhD in computer science, AI/ML, applied mathematics, or a closely related technical field, preferably completed before the start date.

  • A record of first-author research, evidenced by peer-reviewed publications or preprints, in AI safety/alignment, AI/ML for cybersecurity, formal methods, or a closely related area.
  • Hands-on experience with foundation models and agentic AI, such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, planning, or multi-agent frameworks, and their failure modes.
  • Strong programming skills (for example, Python and modern ML frameworks) and experience building reproducible experiments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to present technically defensible arguments to scientific and engineering audiences.
  • Scientific rigor in characterizing model and agent behavior, including uncertainty, limitations, failure conditions, and the strength of supporting evidence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with policy engines, authorization languages (for example, OPA/Rego or Cedar), or formal verification tools.
  • Experience fine-tuning or evaluating foundation models for scientific or biomedical domains.
  • Exposure to privacy-preserving ML, data de-identification, or data provenance, including their limitations.
  • Interest in life sciences or another regulated, high-stakes domain
  • Open-source contributions to AI safety, evaluation, or security tooling.

 

Location

This position will be located at one of our offices in: Beerse, Belgium; Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States; Raritan, New Jersey, United States. Hybrid work arrangements apply.

jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager (CSM)
jobs.description_text:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.
 
At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.
 
AI Fearlessly.


New Role  |  AI-Led Engagement  |  Volume Enterprise Book of Business 


The Role:

This is a new role in the Global Customer Success Organisation at TrendAI. The traditional Customer Success Manager model is being rewritten for the AI economy. As part of the Scaled Customer Success team, you operate an AI-powered engagement system that gives thousands of our customers the proactive support they have never had before, with a clear focus on driving adoption at scale so they achieve their business outcomes with TrendAI Vision One™.


The Scaled Customer Success Manager owns adoption and customer outcomes across the customer lifecycle for a large book of business of Volume Enterprise customers, by directing a team of AI agents and acting as the Human in the Loop (HITL). You do not manage accounts one check-in at a time. You design, supervise and improve the agent-led motion, read portfolio data to spot adoption patterns and risks, and tell customers what to do next, not just how things are going. When an account needs a trusted advisor, you are that advisor.


This role sits within the Global Customer Success Organisation and works closely with the wider CS Organisation, CSTAs, Retention Managers, CS Operations, and the Global Trend IQ team, who build and maintain the virtual CSM platform. Together, you drive customer outcomes and positively impact GRR and NRR across the customer portfolio.


The Responsibilities:

  • Triage the daily agent escalation queue and your book of business by adoption health, risk and urgency, using dashboards and agent summaries to prioritise attention.
  • Review, edit and approve AI-drafted customer communications, verifying alert details, risk scores and product references for accuracy, tone and brand alignment.
  • Monitor agent confidence scores, adoption campaign performance and escalation patterns, flagging systemic issues to CS Operations and Global IQ Engineering.
  • Engage directly with customers on escalations where the agent-led motion isn’t enough, taking over complex, technical or sensitive conversations, guiding mitigation of TrendAI Vision One™ security alerts, and handling escalations through the Global Risk Process, with Support, Product and leadership as needed. 
  • Drive adoption at scale across your book of business: resolve onboarding blockers and missed adoption milestones, and turn consumption and adoption data into prescriptive recommendations that move customers through the adoption lifecycle and protect GRR.
  • Qualify expansion signals from adoption and consumption data and hand them to Account Managers and Account Executives with a clear business case.
  • Give structured feedback on AI drafts, set agent plays, triggers and guardrails, and log defects to continuously improve agent performance and the scaled CS playbook.
  • Share the voice of the customer with Product, Support and Marketing, and work with CS Managers and the Global Trend IQ team to align escalation thresholds, engagement standards and platform improvements.
  • Report on book-of-business adoption, GRR, NRR and Vision One™ adoption metrics within the CS operating model cadence, including quarterly business reviews.
  • Coordinate with Services (MDR, IR and Professional Services) on retainer and consumption tracking, in line with the agreed RACI for shared customer engagements.

You Are:

  • Built for scale: You manage a high-throughput queue across a large book of business while keeping a close eye on the detail of each individual account.
  • Quality-minded: You review AI-generated content critically, catching errors in tone, accuracy and relevance before they reach a customer.
  • A clear, professional communicator: When you step into a customer conversation, you build credibility and trust.
  • Curious about AI: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you’re interested in how AI tools work and how to make them better.
  • Process-driven: You follow established workflows, log outcomes diligently and speak up when something isn’t working.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: This is a new role with evolving processes, and you’re at ease with things not being fully defined from day one.
  • Customer-centric: You keep a real person in mind with every email you approve, and you are comfortable hosting customer calls, webinars and live conversations.

You Have:

  • AI fluency: Experience reviewing or quality-checking AI-generated content and ability to use AI tools and insights to personalise customer engagement, predict churn and recommend next-best actions.
  • 3+ years in customer success, services or support within enterprise software or cybersecurity, with a track record of driving adoption and customer outcomes.
  • Solid technical foundation, preferably in cybersecurity and security concepts (EDR/XDR/NDR).
  • Comfortable with consumption and value metrics, and ability to read usage data and dashboards to make data-backed recommendations for adoption and expansion motions.
  • Experience with customer success platforms, CRM and collaboration tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, both independently and in a team.
  • Fluent in written & spoken English & Spanish, French is an advantage

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with TrendAI products, especially Vision One™
  • Experience with AI tools, prompt engineering, or working alongside automated systems.

At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. We like to have fun while taking our culture seriously. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to this regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, nationality, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or veteran status. We do not allow discrimination or harassment of any kind.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner (15 month contract)
jobs.description_text: TransferMate – a subsidiary of CluneTech  – was established in 2010 when we began working with regulators around the world to secure licenses to operate as a global payment’s provider. With a global payments network covering 200+ countries and territories, TransferMate have established partnerships with some of the largest banks, fintechs and software providers in the world. The combination of our regulated network, award winning technology and strategic partnerships culminated in 2022 when the business achieved Unicorn status.    Our team is dedicated to delivering the best possible experience for our partners and their customers. We know that a happy team is one that performs at the highest level and our  #OneTeam ethos  encourages mutual support, respect, recognition, and rewards. In Ireland, we have been recognised as a Great Place to Work for 11 consecutive years, with 35 offices worldwide, we do business across 100+ countries on a daily basis.       Senior HR Business Partner – Maternity Leave Cover       We are seeking an experienced Senior HR Business Partner to join our People team on a 15-month fixed-term contract.      Reporting to the Head of HR, the Senior HR Business Partner is responsible for providing strategic and operational HR leadership across the organisation, ensuring best practice people management, employment law compliance, and the delivery of key HR programmes. The role partners closely with leaders and managers to drive business performance, foster a positive organisational culture, and support the employee lifecycle from recruitment through to performance management and employee relations.     This is a broad and varied role that requires someone who can move comfortably between strategic business partnering and the practical delivery of complex HR matters.      This is a hybrid role and the candidate may be required to attend the Kilkenny Office up to 2 days per week.       Key Responsibilities:      Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership:     · Partner with the Executive Leadership Team and senior managers to translate business priorities into effective people strategies and initiatives.      Act as a trusted strategic adviser, providing constructive challenge and practical solutions on organisational, leadership and people matters.      Identify emerging people risks and opportunities and provide evidence-based recommendations.      Support organisational design, workforce planning, change and other strategic business initiatives, ensuring people implications are effectively managed.      Drive initiatives that strengthen organisational effectiveness, employee engagement, culture and long-term capability.         Global Employee Relations, Global Employment Law & Policy:       Act as a trusted advisor to managers on all HR and employee relations matters.      Provide strategic and operational HR guidance to support business objectives.      Maintain strong working knowledge of employment legislation across all countries of operation.      Ensure employment contracts, policies, and HR practices remain legally compliant, fit for purpose and up to date.      Lead and support complex employee relations matters, including performance management, grievances, disciplinary processes, absence management, probation, workplace accommodations, protected conversations, restructuring, redundancy and termination processes.      Develop managers capability through coaching, training, guidance materials, and practical tools.      Strengthen and maintain HR resources, including templates, guides, and learning materials.         Leadership, Talent & Organisational Effectiveness:       Coach and challenge leaders and managers to strengthen leadership capability, accountability and consistency in people management        Support effective performance, feedback, development and talent practices across the organisation.      Partner with leaders on organisational challenges, change and workforce transitions.      Work with the recruitment team and hiring managers to support effective global talent acquisition and a positive candidate experience. Participating in interviews and selection processes as required.      Contribute to workforce planning, succession planning and the development of future organisational capability.        Provide ongoing guidance, practical solutions, communication templates, and training to ensure consistent management practices.      Partner with leaders to successfully implement strategic HR initiatives and programmes.         Performance Management & People Analytics:       Lead the Company's bi-annual performance management cycle, ensuring effective goal setting, feedback, development and accountability.      Coach managers on effective performance management and support consistent application of the process.      Analyse performance outcomes and broader people trends to identify organisational priorities and opportunities.      Provide the Leadership Team with meaningful HR metrics, insights and recommendations across performance, engagement, employee relations and workforce planning.         Reward, Workforce Planning & HR Operations:       Provide strategic HR input into workforce planning, budgeting, salary reviews, headcount forecasting and employee cost modelling.      Partner with Payroll and Finance to ensure accurate people data and effective management of employee-related costs.      Liaise with Payroll regarding employee changes, new hires, transfers, and leavers.      Contribute to annual budgeting and workforce planning exercises, including headcount forecasting, salary reviews, and employee cost modelling.      Manage the global annual bonus process in conjunction with the payroll team.      Ensure core HR processes, systems and ways of working are effective, scalable and aligned with organisational needs.         Team Management:       Provide leadership and line management support to the global HR team, currently consisting of:      o Global HR Specialist (Ireland)    o HR, Payroll & Admin Specialist (Philippines)      Support team development through regular coaching, performance management, and professional growth opportunities.      Ensure effective workload planning and delivery of key HR objectives across the team.         Governance & HR Projects:       Participate in global HR audits and compliance reviews, as required.      Lead and contribute to strategic HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives.      Support effective internal HR communication and employee engagement initiatives.      Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity and professionalism.      Undertake other responsibilities reasonably required to support the organisation's strategic and operational objectives.           Key Competencies:       Advanced knowledge of employment legislation and HR best practices across multiple jurisdictions.      Strong commercial awareness with the ability to align people strategies to business objectives.      Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively where required.      Strong analytical and reporting skills with the ability to interpret HR metrics and provide meaningful insights.      Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing, policy development, training delivery, and presentation skills.      High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential matters.      Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.      Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and HR technology platforms.         Experience and Qualifications:       Minimum of 8-10 years' progressive HR experience, with at least 2-4 years operating at Senior HR Business Partner level.      Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business, Employment Law, or a related discipline.      CIPD qualification is desired.      Additional qualifications in Employment Law, Coaching, Mediation, Organisational Development, or Change Management would be advantageous.      Proven experience providing strategic and operational HR support within a fast-paced, multinational organisation.      Demonstrated expertise in employee relations, employment law, performance management, organisational development, and change management.      Experience managing complex employee relations cases and providing risk-based advice to senior stakeholders.      Exposure to supporting global workforces across multiple jurisdictions and employment law frameworks.      Experience partnering with senior leaders to drive business performance, employee engagement, and organisational effectiveness.      Experience working with HRIS and performance management systems, preferably StaffCircle or similar platforms.      Experience contributing to recruitment, workforce planning, budgeting, and payroll-related processes.       Recognised as a both a Great Place to Work and Deloitte Best Managed Company, we believe that recognition goes much deeper than just financial rewards. Therefore, in addition to a competitive salary, we also offer an exclusive benefits package that includes:      Flexible Working Policy with a combination of remote and office working and a flexible approach to working hours    Competitive annual leave     Employee-led CSR Programme    Rewards & Recognition    Employee Wellbeing Programme, CluneTech Life      This job description is intended as a summary of the primary responsibilities for this position. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties an individual in this position might be asked to perform or that may be required either now or in the future.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel – Corporate and Enterprise Legal Services
jobs.description_text:
Have impact! 


We are currently recruiting for a Legal counsel. You will have a positive impact as part of a technically proficient and solutions-oriented team supporting and advising on regulation, governance and strategic initiatives relating to the Vanguard enterprise. 

You will be a member of the Corporate and Enterprise Legal Services unit within the Europe Legal team reporting to the head of the unit.

Corporate and Enterprise Legal Services supports corporate and enterprise priorities covering strategic business priorities, regulatory advice, procurement and commercial contracts, and Legal Operations, contributing to a strong and connected Legal function.


Join us and help protect the millions who trust us with their futures! 


In this role you will

  • Provide technical legal and regulatory advice and analysis on EU and UK regulation, guidance and other measures in respect of key enterprise topics.  Advise on the practical implementation and integration of these requirements into the Vanguard business and its risk, governance and controls framework
  • Advise, support and collaborate with the Corporate Operations and Change Management functions and other stakeholders including Compliance, Public Policy, Risk and the business units to assess and respond to the impacts of emerging regulation and deliver on the implementation of new regulation and matters arising from it in the BAU business operations
  • Provide technical legal and regulatory advice and analysis on complex enterprise business change initiatives, including relating to the group regional organization, regulatory authorisations and corporate infrastructure
  • Conduct research, analysis and horizon scanning on regulation applicable to the Vanguard enterprise
  • Support the wider Corporate and Enterprise Legal services unit and the wider OGC Legal team as needed
  • Partner with OGC teams globally as needed, as well as colleagues in other areas of the Vanguard business
  • Develop and maintain knowledge and awareness of the investment industry, regulatory and/or policy changes with potential impact on Vanguard’s European group companies and operations, including representing Vanguard on various industry bodies
  • Participate in special projects and perform other duties as required

 

What it takes

  • Qualified lawyer with minimum three-five years’ PQE spent working in-house for an international asset management organization and/or in a private practice law firm, handling a variety of financial services, legal and regulatory matters
  • Experience in advising buy side businesses, familiarity with retail financial services regulation is an advantage
  • Good working knowledge of foundational regulatory frameworks including MiFID, UCITS and AIFM
  • Credible technical skills and experience interpreting regulation applicable to the asset management sector
  • Understanding of the priorities of UK regulators and policy makers. Experience in responding to consultation papers and implementing compliance with regulatory change projects, including advising businesses and other stakeholders directly on new and live regulations
  • A demonstrated ability to work on complex legal issues and to function in a high volume / fast-paced environment with multiple and diverse responsibilities, managing a varied and changing caseload
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder relationship management, negotiation, analytical and drafting skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently on demanding legal issues and to tight deadlines

 

Special Factors 

  • Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position
  • This is a hybrid position and would require you to work in the office 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday)

Why Vanguard? 

Vanguard is a different kind of investment company. It was founded in the United States in 1975 on a simple but revolutionary idea: that an investment company should manage its funds solely in the interests of its clients. 

 

This is a philosophy that has helped millions of people around the world to achieve their goals with low-cost, uncomplicated investments. 

 

It's what we stand for: value to investors. 

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.title: Associate Legal Counsel - ESG & Investment Stewardship
jobs.description_text:
Have impact! 


We are looking for an Associate Legal Counsel to be a part of our solutions-oriented Legal team supporting and advising on regulation relating to sustainability topics pertinent to Vanguard’s funds and enterprise as well as assisting in providing legal support to our Investment Stewardship function. 


You will be a member of the Product and Investment Services Legal team within the broader Europe Legal function, reporting initially to the head of the team and working closely with another team member with a similar core remit.

Product and Investment Services Legal supports our Product, Investment Management and Investment Stewardship functions in Europe covering all fund launches & funds maintenance legal support, our Investment Stewardship (Stewardship) function as well as legal advisory support (in partnership with Compliance) of our investment management function.


The role will work in close partnership with another member of the team with a similar core remit,  supporting ESG and Stewardship initiatives, including regulatory implementation projects, disclosure and reporting obligations, legal research, horizon scanning and ad hoc day-to-day legal advisory and research work.


Join us and help protect the millions who trust us with their futures! 


In this role you will

  • Provide legal and regulatory advice on ESG requirements, supporting the implementation of UK and EU regulations across products, governance, risk and control frameworks
  • Review and drafting of disclosures for BAU periodic disclosures and reports concerning specific ESG obligations
  • Advise on and review annual and other reports, including the Annual Stewardship Code Report, Investment Stewardship Report, Pension UK template, SRD II and other sustainability reports containing Stewardship disclosures
  • Support regulatory change project working groups and/or workstreams implementing regulations, including advising on SRD II and other regulatory policies & disclosures
  • Conduct legal and regulatory research and prepare concise outputs for stakeholders
  • Assist with horizon scanning and regulatory monitoring activities and prepare impact assessments on emerging regulatory developments
  • Provide day-to-day legal advice on ESG and Stewardship matters, including support on BAU queries relating to live regulation
  • Build and maintain effective relationships across business functions and deliver practical legal advice to key stakeholder
  • Develop and maintain knowledge and awareness of the investment industry, regulatory and/or policy changes with potential impact on Vanguard’s European group companies and operations
  • Use legal technology and AI-enabled tools appropriately to support research, horizon scanning and delivery efficiency
  • Support the wider Product & Investment Services Legal team and the wider OGC Legal team as needed
  • Participate in special projects and perform other duties as required

 

What it takes

  • Qualified lawyer with minimum two years’ PQE gained either in-house within an international asset management organisation and/or in private practice or consultancy, advising on financial services legal and regulatory matters

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to build effective stakeholder relationship, negotiation, analytical and drafting skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to work on a variety of legal issues and to tight deadlines

We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
